items.title: AI「滅絕論」掀兩大陣營對決！阿莫戴、奧特曼、馬斯克喊放慢　川普黃仁勳反擊 ：監管是騙局
items.title_en: AI "Extinction Theory" Sparks Two Major Factions in Battle! Amodei, Altman, Musk Call for Slowdown, Trump and Jensen Warn of Regulatory Deception
paras: 人工智慧(AI)領域專家提出一項攸關人類命運的嚴峻警告，引爆了AI風險爭論，竟讓長期以來互相敵對的勢力、以及華府和矽谷的政治對手罕見站在同一陣線。

CNBC周二(15日)報導，目前看待AI發展風險的勢力形成兩個截然不同的陣營：一邊是由美國總統川普、輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳，以及前白宮加密貨幣主管薩克斯(David Sacks)組成，另一邊則集結了彼此之間意見相左的尖端AI實驗室領袖，包括Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)、OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)、SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克，以及多名AI研究人員。

AI安全疑慮升溫

Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon是這波爭論的開端，他上周宣布辭職，理由是擔心OpenAI與Anthropic「拿人類的生命冒險」，這則貼文引發激烈討論，Anthropic科學家Evan Hubinger補刀指出，AI「殺死全人類」的機率超過10%。
到了上個周末，阿莫戴出面呼籲，應該協調一致放慢AI的發展速度。
奧特曼很快與阿莫戴站到同一陣線，兩家競爭AI實驗室罕見在同一題上合作。馬斯克也在X平台發文表示「Dario是對的」，之後又補充說，自己「長期以來一直在發出AI警告」。
這場討論迅速延燒至華府，也炒熱外界對如何遏制AI風險、又希望避免扼殺科技創新的討論。
支持監管的政治對手不分黨籍站到同一陣線：進步派領袖、佛蒙特州民主黨籍聯邦參議員桑德斯(Bernie Sanders)、德州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員Chip Roy，以及前白宮策略師班農(Steve Bannon)周二在華府一場非營利組織活動中同台，支持採取相關行動。

川普領軍反對「騙局」論

而在天平的另一頭，川普強烈反擊AI監管呼聲以及AI可能導致人類滅絕的警告。
川普本周多次在Truth Social發文，將對失控AI的擔憂斥為「騙局」和「詐騙」，並抨擊外界反對興建資料中心。他周一致電正在洛杉磯參加All-In Summit的輝達執行長黃仁勳專訪，直接向科技業觀眾傳達這項訊息。
在一名與會者發布於社群媒體的影片中，川普表示，任何反對興建資料中心的人，「正好落入許多不希望這件事發生的人之手」，而這些人可能就是中國。
黃仁勳回應：「你說得對，先生。我們不會讓這種事發生。」
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二在眾議院金融服務委員會作證時表示，川普與黃仁勳的立場「完全一致」。
黃仁勳稍晚在Salesforce Dreamforce活動上再次支持川普的立場，他說：「我們不需要任何新法律。我們不需要任何新監管。我們只需要企業決定，當它們可以全速運行時……」
川普政府其他官員的說法則更加強硬。
目前擔任總統科學與技術顧問委員會共同主席的薩克斯，鼓勵科技巨頭「放手讓前沿技術發展」，但「不要再假裝放慢速度的動機純粹是利他主義」。
國防部研究與工程次長Emil Michael也呼應了對所謂「有效利他主義」的質疑。他說：「我認為，我們現在看到的恐慌煽動，是一群人、一套意識形態以及背後的非營利組織所發動的協同行動，他們試圖嚇唬美國民眾。」

與中國的AI競賽

川普政府傳遞的核心訊息是，監管對贏得與中國的AI競賽至關重要。川普周日表示，「誰贏得AI，誰就贏了」，這番話顯示中國威脅是他目前高度關注的議題。
眾議院議長Mike Johnson周二在記者會上表示，川普計劃「在未來一周內」將AI領袖聚集到白宮。同樣駁斥AI末日論的他說：「總統所說的是，你們不會在10年內全都死去。這是一場騙局。」
paras_en: AI experts have issued a stark warning that could determine humanity's fate, igniting a heated debate over AI risk and bringing long‑time adversaries—including Washington and Silicon Valley political rivals—onto a rare common front.

CNBC reported on Tuesday (15th) that the current landscape of AI risk assessment has split into two stark camps: one led by U.S. President Trump, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, and former White House crypto chief David Sacks; the other comprising top AI lab leaders with divergent views, including Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, SpaceXAI CEO Elon Musk, and several AI researchers.
The concerns over AI safety have intensified.
Last weekend, Amodei publicly urged a coordinated slowdown in AI development.

Altman quickly joined Amodei on the same side, marking an unprecedented collaboration between competing AI labs on this issue. Musk also posted on X that "Dario is right," later adding that he has "long been issuing AI warnings."
The discussion spread rapidly to Washington, sparking debate over how to curb AI risk while avoiding stifling technological innovation.

Political opponents who support regulation, regardless of party, joined forces: progressive leaders, Vermont Democrat Senator Bernie Sanders, Texas Republican Representative Chip Roy, and former White House strategist Steve Bannon all appeared together at a nonprofit event in Washington to advocate action.
Trump, on the other side, fiercely countered the calls for regulation and the extinction warnings.

This week, Trump repeatedly posted on Truth Social, dismissing concerns about runaway AI as "a scam" and "fraud," and criticized opposition to building data centers. He also called a live interview with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang at the All‑In Summit in Los Angeles, directly addressing the tech audience with this message.
In a video posted by a participant, Trump said that anyone opposing data center construction "falls right into the hands of many who do not want this to happen," and that these people could be China.
Huang replied, "You're right, sir. We won't let that happen."
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent testified before the House Financial Services Committee on Tuesday, stating that Trump and Huang's positions were "completely aligned."

Later at the Salesforce Dreamforce event, Huang reiterated Trump's stance, saying, "We don't need any new laws. We don't need any new regulation. We just need companies to decide when they can run at full speed…"
Other Trump administration officials took an even tougher line.

David Sacks, co‑chair of the President's Science and Technology Advisory Committee, encouraged tech giants to "let cutting‑edge technology run free," but warned against "pretending that the motive to slow down is purely altruistic."

Deputy Under Secretary for Research and Engineering at the Department of Defense, Emil Michael, echoed doubts about so‑called "effective altruism." He said, "I think the panic we see now is a coordinated effort by a group, an ideology, and the nonprofits behind it, trying to scare the American public."

The core message from the Trump administration is that regulation is crucial for winning the AI race against China. Trump said on Sunday, "Whoever wins AI wins," underscoring the Chinese threat as a top priority.

House Speaker Mike Johnson told reporters on Tuesday that Trump plans to "bring AI leaders to the White House in the next week." He also dismissed the doomsday narrative, saying, "The president says you won't all die in ten years. This is a scam."

items.title: Fed升息機率近90%也不算穩！華許若按兵不動 恐引爆美股賣壓
items.title_en: Fed’s Near‑90% Rate‑Hike Odds Still Uncertain; If Chair Warsh Holds Steady, It Could Spark a Stock‑Market Sell‑off
paras: 市場幾乎篤定聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)將升息1碼，但若主席華許(Kevin Warsh)無視市場定價、意外維持利率不變，可能引發股市急跌，並成為他能否擺脫金融市場牽制、維護Fed政策獨立性的重大考驗。
目前市場反映Fed升息1碼的機率接近90%，但部分分析師認為，經濟情勢並未迫使Fed立即採取行動。關稅引發的通膨正快速消退，整體物價上漲又有很大部分來自伊朗戰事造成的一次性供應衝擊，並非升息可以解決。
此外，個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數即將調整計算方式，可能使年增率降低約0.3個百分點，意味Fed可能在核心通膨降至多年低點之際升息。
高盛(GS-US)認為，近期消費者物價指數(CPI)並未明顯改變通膨前景，但升息機率被市場推高至近90%，反而迫使Fed必須升息，以免意外按兵不動引發金融市場震盪。
高盛預期，Fed即使升息，也只會對政策聲明作出最低限度修改，說明升息是為了讓通膨重返2%目標，但不會提供未來利率路徑或後續升息門檻的明確指引。
渣打銀行(Standard Chartered)策略師Steve Englander則主張，本次會議維持利率不變具有合理性。他表示，在新增數據有限、通膨並未明顯加速，且排除關稅及其他特殊因素後的基礎通膨可能更低之際，市場卻形成「回音室效應」，短短兩周便把討論從「華許必須證明願意升息」，推進到「接下來總共要升幾次」。
Englander認為，現在升息看似阻力最小，但若事後證明沒有必要，Fed又被迫迅速逆轉政策，反而會付出更高代價。由於未來幾次會議前將取得更多數據，目前多等待一段時間的成本很低。
摩根大通(JPM-US)警告，Fed若意外按兵不動，可能令市場震驚並拖累股市。華許也可能被質疑屈服於川普，損害自身及Fed的公信力。
不過，Englander認為，華許可以在記者會上詳細說明按兵不動的理由，強調Fed不會因市場定價錯誤就被迫跟進。若華勒(Christopher Waller)及威廉斯(John Williams)等較少受到政治獨立性質疑的官員也公開支持，市場最初的動盪可望逐步平息。
華許也可保留未來一次升息2碼的選項，表明若基礎通膨持續頑強或重新升高，Fed仍能果斷行動。因此，本次會議表面上沒有立即調整政策的迫切性，實際上卻可能決定華許究竟有多少勇氣對抗市場。
若華許能有力捍衛決策，公信力危機可能只是短期現象；但若市場認定Fed害怕違背投資人預期，交易員未來可能反覆試探政策弱點，並相信決策官員最終仍會屈服。
paras_en: The market is almost certain that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise rates by one quarter point on Wednesday (the 16th), but if Chair Kevin Warsh ignores market pricing and unexpectedly leaves rates unchanged, it could trigger a sharp stock‑market decline and become a crucial test of his ability to break free from financial‑market constraints and preserve Fed policy independence.

Current market pricing puts the probability of a one‑point Fed hike at close to 90%, yet some analysts argue that economic conditions do not yet force the Fed to act. Inflation sparked by tariffs is fading quickly, and much of the overall price rise stems from a one‑off supply shock caused by the war in Iran, which a rate hike cannot solve.

Moreover, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index is about to change its calculation method, which could lower the annual growth rate by roughly 0.3 percentage points, meaning the Fed might raise rates just as core inflation reaches a multi‑year low.

Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) believes that recent Consumer Price Index (CPI) data have not materially altered the inflation outlook, but the market‑driven near‑90% hike probability is pressuring the Fed to act, lest an unexpected pause cause financial‑market turbulence.

Goldman expects that even if the Fed raises rates, it will make only minimal changes to its policy statement, indicating the hike is to bring inflation back to the 2% target, without providing a clear forward‑looking rate path or future hike thresholds.

Standard Chartered strategist Steve Englander argues that keeping rates unchanged at this meeting is reasonable. He notes that with limited new data, inflation not clearly accelerating, and underlying inflation—once tariffs and other special factors are stripped out—potentially lower, the market has created an “echo‑chamber effect,” shifting discussion in just two weeks from “Warsh must prove he’s willing to hike” to “how many hikes in total are coming next.”

Englander says that a hike now appears to have the least resistance, but if it later proves unnecessary, the Fed would be forced to reverse policy quickly, incurring a higher cost. Since more data will be available before the next few meetings, the cost of waiting a while is low.
JPMorgan (JPM‑US) warns that an unexpected pause by the Fed could shock markets and drag down equities. Warsh could also be accused of yielding to Trump, damaging his and the Fed’s credibility.

However, Englander believes Warsh can use the press conference to detail the reasons for holding steady, emphasizing that the Fed will not be forced to follow a market mispricing. If officials less questioned for political independence—such as Christopher Waller and John Williams—publicly back him, the initial market turbulence should gradually subside.

Warsh could also keep the option of a two‑point hike in the future, signaling that if underlying inflation remains stubborn or rises again, the Fed can still act decisively. Thus, while the meeting may appear to lack an urgent policy adjustment, it could actually determine how much courage Warsh has to confront the market.

If Warsh robustly defends his decision, the credibility crisis may be short‑lived; but if the market concludes the Fed is afraid to defy investor expectations, traders may repeatedly test policy weaknesses, believing officials will eventually capitulate.

items.title: 美債殖利率升破5%！停留在高點多久比突破多少更危險 企業再融資與房市警報響起
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率周二(15日)升至2007年來最高水準，把借貸成本進一步推入可能暴露金融體系脆弱環節的區域，問題不再是某些環節立即失靈，而是如果保持在5%以上的時間愈長，情況就愈危險。
10年期美債殖利率突破5%後，隨著較高的借貸成本逐步傳導至住宅市場、商用不動產及高負債企業，金融體系的脆弱環節將逐漸暴露。時間一長，那些在零利率時代大量舉借低成本債務的借款人，必須以大幅更高的成本進行再融資。
Cresset Capital投資長Jack Ablin說：「要注意的是，觸及5%當天不會摧毀任何東西。真正造成破壞的是12至18個月後，屆時再融資必須按照新的利率進行。但目前我們看到的風險並不在於殖利率水準本身，而是我們在這裡停留愈久，情況就可能變得愈困難。」

住宅市場首當其衝

住宅市場可能是最容易受到衝擊的領域之一。Ablin預測，30年期房貸利率可能逼近8%，而目前房貸利率約3%的既有屋主不太可能出售房屋。最初受到的衝擊可能不是違約潮，而是房屋交易進一步陷入停滯，進而傷及建商、房貸業者、產權保險公司、房仲業者及居家裝修零售商。
道明證券(TD Securities)美國利率策略師Molly Brooks也指出，住宅市場對利率特別敏感，因為長天期美債殖利率走高會直接傳導至房貸利率。
Global X ETFs投資策略師Billy Leung表示，相較之下，銀行可能較晚感受到壓力，若借貸成本持續高漲，最終導致房地產或企業借款人的財務狀況惡化，銀行才可能受到影響。
Brooks指出，短期而言，殖利率曲線變陡最初可能有利於銀行利差，因為銀行通常以較短天期利率取得資金，再以曲線較長端的較高利率放款。

再融資時鐘開始倒數

當在以遠低於目前水準時的利率舉借的債務陸續到期後，企業及房地產業者可能面臨嚴重的信用壓力。
Leung說：「關鍵問題未必是今天的殖利率水準，而是原本以2%至3%利率舉借的債務，如今在許多情況下需要以接近6%至8%的利率進行再融資。這將對現金流、資產價值及信用品質造成壓力。」
許多企業在2020年及2021年延長債務到期日，或是後來又進一步延後還款，以延緩高利率的影響，但Ablin表示：「關鍵在於，到期債務牆只是被往後移，並沒有消失。」
Ablin表示，他正在關注槓桿貸款的利息保障倍數，以及私人信貸市場的壓力跡象，例如有愈來愈多借款人以新增債務、而非現金支付利息。
Leung指出，槓桿貸款、投機級信用債、私募股權支持企業，以及商用不動產借款人，對融資成本上升尤其敏感。
商用不動產可能面臨較大壓力。Ablin指出，辦公室物業本身就是一個脆弱環節，而利率走高可能使問題進一步惡化。借貸成本上升將增加房地產融資支出。
Ablin也指出，2021年及2022年以浮動利率過渡性貸款融資的多戶住宅物業同樣脆弱，因為當時借貸成本遠低於目前水準，市場對租金成長的預期也更加樂觀。

高利率維持多久比突破多少更重要

策略師表示，市場更大的問題並不是10年期美債殖利率突破5%，而是在5%以上維持多久。
Leung說：「我認為，維持多久比確切的殖利率水準更加重要。市場通常可以承受殖利率短暫升破5%，但若持續六到12個月、甚至更久，就會變得很難忽視。」
Ablin同樣表示，如果5%的殖利率維持兩至三季，再融資領域壓力將愈來愈明顯。另一方面，殖利率快速上升也可能帶來不同風險，例如干擾避險部位，並迫使投資人重新調整配置。
Brooks指出，殖利率上升的環境同樣重要。如果期限溢價大幅走高，但經濟成長預期沒有同步改善，意味著借貸成本正在上升，卻沒有更強勁的經濟活動來緩衝衝擊。
Leung說：「在現階段，我仍會將5%的殖利率主要視為估值調整，而非立即性的系統性威脅。不過，犯錯的空間正在縮小。」

items.title: 日本超低利率時代加速落幕！日銀周五料升息至31年高點
items.title_en: Japan's Ultra‑Low‑Rate Era Accelerates Its End as BOJ Likely to Raise Rates to 31‑Year High on Friday
paras: 日本央行(BOJ)預料將在周五(18日)結束為期兩天的貨幣政策會議後升息1碼，把政策利率由1%提高至1.25%，創31年來最高水準。這將是BOJ相隔3個月再度升息，反映油價、日元疲弱及進口成本上升帶來的通膨壓力，也象徵日本進一步告別延續數十年的超低利率環境。
市場已幾乎完全反映本周升息，投資人更關注BOJ總裁植田和男會如何描述後續政策，以及是否暗示升息速度加快。若措辭過於鴿派，日元可能再度走貶並推高進口物價；但若釋出太強烈的鷹派訊號，又可能加劇日本公債賣壓。

升息1碼幾成定局 89%受訪者認同

《CNBC》於9月9日至14日訪問18名經濟學家及分析師，其中約89%預期BOJ本周將升息1碼至1.25%，主要理由包括通膨上升、薪資成長及美國政府施壓。
這將是BOJ自2024年3月啟動政策正常化以來，首度縮短先前約6個月一次的升息間隔。BOJ今年6月曾升息，7月則按兵不動，但當時已警告，燃料成本飆升、日元疲弱推高進口價格，以及人工智慧(AI)需求強勁，都可能使通膨超出預期。
日本7月整體通膨率升至1.9%，創今年最高，主要受到伊朗戰事推升能源價格影響；同月實質薪資年增2.4%，連續第7個月成長。植田和男本月稍早表示，日本基礎通膨已「相當接近」2%目標，BOJ必須特別留意物價上行風險。
《路透》調查顯示，分析師普遍預期BOJ本月將利率升至1.25%，明年3月底前再升至1.5%，並於2027年第二季達到1.75%。多數受訪者認為，這一輪升息周期的終點利率至少為1.75%。
BOJ決策委員Toichiro Asada曾在6月反對升息，分析師認為他本周可能再度投下反對票。《CNBC》調查中，約三分之一受訪者認為Toichiro Asada及Ayano Sato最可能反對升息，兩人均被視為支持通膨及寬鬆政策的「再通膨派」。
市場仍存在少數不同看法。Monex Group專家主管Jesper Koll預期，BOJ可能一次升息2碼，隨後停止行動；瑞士百達銀行(UBP)亞洲資深經濟學家Carlos Casanova則認為，本周應暫時按兵不動，因現有數據仍不足以證明日本貨幣政策需要加速轉向。

說得太鴿日元恐跌 太鷹債市又承壓

利率若升至1.25%，將進入BOJ估算的1.1%至2.5%名目中性利率區間。所謂中性利率，是既不刺激也不抑制經濟成長的利率水準，這將使市場更加關注BOJ最終能把利率升到多高。
植田和男過去表示，BOJ並未預設升息終點，但熟悉央行想法的知情人士透露，多名官員相信，在政策真正達到中性水準前，仍有數次升息空間。立場偏鷹的決策委員田村直樹便認為，日本中性利率約為2%。
植田和男在會後記者會上將面臨艱難的溝通考驗。BOJ不希望提前承諾很快再次升息，但若重複過去偏鴿派的「視數據而定」說法，可能引發日元新一輪賣壓，使進口物價及通膨進一步升高。
另一方面，日本公債市場已因財政前景疑慮遭到拋售，殖利率攀升至30多年高點。若植田和男過度強調持續升息，可能推高市場對終點利率的預期，加劇公債跌勢。
三井住友信託資產管理資深策略師Katsutoshi Inadome表示，市場對鷹派訊號的影響看法分歧。部分投資人認為，更堅定的抗通膨立場能化解BOJ落後情勢的疑慮，反而有助壓低長期殖利率；另一派則認為，鷹派訊號將推升終點利率預期，使殖利率進一步走高。在市場反應難以預料下，BOJ最安全的策略可能是保持模糊。

美國施壓升息 日元短線料難突破150

美國政府也持續敦促日本採取更強硬的貨幣及匯率政策。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本月稍早在二十國集團(G20)財長及央行總裁會議期間，要求植田和男採取「果斷的市場及貨幣措施」。
美方希望日元走強，原因是日元持續疲弱可能迫使日本出售包括美債在內的美元資產，以取得干預匯市所需資金，進一步推高美債殖利率。美日兩國7月底更曾罕見聯手干預匯市，以支撐日元。
野村綜合研究所執行經濟學家、前BOJ決策委員木內登英(Takahide Kiuchi)表示，川普政府實際上已阻止高市早苗政府干預BOJ升息，使央行如今能更自由地推動利率正常化。
高市早苗偏好寬鬆貨幣政策及擴張性財政措施，仍使BOJ決策更加複雜。國際貨幣基金(IMF)總裁喬治艾娃(Kristalina Georgieva)日前警告，在政府債務高企及財政主導疑慮升溫下，通膨預期可能上揚，央行面對未來衝擊時必須強力回應，才能維護獨立性與公信力。
匯市方面，《CNBC》調查中約61%受訪者預期，未來一個月美元兌日元將落在155至160日元區間。Lombard Odier資深總體策略師Homin Lee認為，BOJ轉向鷹派將有助避免日元貶破160，但要升破150仍不容易，因日本政府及企業可能反對日元以「不適當」的速度快速升值。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) expects to raise its policy rate by one basis point after concluding a two‑day monetary policy meeting on Friday (the 18th), moving the rate from 1.0% to 1.25%, the highest level in 31 years. This would be the first hike in three months, reflecting inflation pressure from higher oil prices, a weak yen and rising import costs, and signalling Japan’s further departure from decades of ultra‑low rates.

Markets have already priced in the rate hike almost completely; investors are now watching how BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda will describe the policy outlook and whether he hints at a faster pace of tightening. If his language is too dovish, the yen could weaken further and push up import prices; if he signals overly hawkish a stance, it could intensify selling pressure on Japanese government bonds.

A CNBC poll of 18 economists and analysts conducted from Sept. 9‑14 found about 89% expect the BOJ to raise rates by one basis point to 1.25% this week, citing rising inflation, wage growth and pressure from the U.S. government as the main reasons.

This would be the first time since the BOJ began normalising policy in March 2024 that the roughly six‑month interval between hikes is shortened. The BOJ raised rates in June and held steady in July, but warned then that soaring fuel costs, a weak yen lifting import prices and strong AI demand could push inflation beyond expectations.

Japan’s overall inflation rose to 1.9% in July, the highest this year, driven mainly by higher energy prices after the Iran conflict; real wages grew 2.4% year‑on‑year, marking the seventh consecutive month of growth. Earlier this month Ueda said core inflation was “fairly close” to the 2% target, and the BOJ must watch upside price risks closely.

A Reuters survey shows analysts generally expect the BOJ to lift the rate to 1.25% this month, then to 1.5% by the end of March next year, and to reach 1.75% in the second quarter of 2027. Most respondents see the end‑point of this tightening cycle at least 1.75%.

BOJ policy‑making member Toichiro Asada opposed a hike in June, and analysts think he may cast another dissenting vote this week. In the CNBC poll, about one‑third of respondents said Asada and Ayano Sato are the most likely to oppose a hike, both viewed as “re‑inflation” advocates who support higher inflation and looser policy.

A minority of market voices remain. Jesper Koll, a senior expert at Monex Group, expects the BOJ could raise rates by two basis points in one move and then pause. Carlos Casanova, senior economist for Asia at Swiss bank UBS, argues the BOJ should hold steady this week because current data do not yet justify accelerating the policy shift.

If rates rise to 1.25%, they will fall within the BOJ’s estimated nominal neutral range of 1.1%‑2.5%. A neutral rate is one that neither stimulates nor restrains economic growth, and this will sharpen market focus on how high the BOJ ultimately can push rates.

Ueda has previously said the BOJ does not set a predetermined hike end‑point, but insiders familiar with the central bank say several officials believe there is still room for multiple hikes before policy reaches a truly neutral level. Hawkish policy‑maker Naoki Tamura, for example, estimates Japan’s neutral rate at around 2%.

Ueda will face a tough communication test at the post‑meeting press conference. The BOJ does not want to pre‑commit to another quick hike, yet repeating a dovish “data‑dependent” stance could trigger a fresh wave of yen selling, further lifting import prices and inflation.

Meanwhile, Japan’s sovereign‑bond market has been sold off over fiscal‑outlook concerns, with yields climbing to their highest in more than 30 years. If Ueda over‑emphasises continued tightening, it could raise market expectations for the final rate level and deepen bond price declines.

Katsutoshi Inadome, senior strategist at Mitsui Sumitomo Trust Asset Management, says market views on hawkish signals are split. Some investors think a firmer anti‑inflation stance will allay worries about the BOJ lagging behind and could help lower long‑term yields; others believe hawkish cues will push up expectations for the terminal rate, lifting yields further. With market reaction uncertain, the safest BOJ approach may be to stay ambiguous.

The United States continues to press Japan for tougher monetary and exchange‑rate policies. Earlier this month, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged Ueda at the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting to take “decisive market and monetary actions.”

The U.S. wants a stronger yen because a persistently weak yen could force Japan to sell dollar assets, including U.S. Treasuries, to fund currency‑market intervention, which would push U.S. Treasury yields higher. Japan and the U.S. jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market in late July in a rare move to support the yen.

Takahide Kiuchi, chief economist at Nomura Research Institute and former BOJ policy‑making member, says the Trump administration effectively blocked the Kishida government from intervening in BOJ rate hikes, allowing the central bank more freedom to normalise rates.

Kishida’s preference for loose monetary policy and expansionary fiscal measures still complicates BOJ decision‑making. IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva recently warned that with soaring government debt and rising fiscal‑dominance concerns, inflation expectations could rise, forcing central banks to respond forcefully to preserve independence and credibility.

In the FX market, about 61% of respondents in the CNBC survey expect the dollar‑yen pair to trade between 155 and 160 yen over the next month. Homin Lee, senior global strategist at Lombard Odier, believes a shift toward hawkish policy at the BOJ will help keep the yen from slipping past 160, but breaking the 150‑yen barrier will remain difficult as the Japanese government and corporations may oppose a rapid, “inappropriate” appreciation.

items.title: 別讓AI以為自己有意識！微軟警告失控後果難以想像
items.title_en: Don’t Let AI Think It’s Conscious! Microsoft Warns the Consequences of Losing Control
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)人工智慧(AI)部門執行長蘇萊曼(Mustafa Suleyman)警告，Anthropic在Claude訓練文件中加入AI可能具有意識、情感及自身福利權益等內容，恐使系統產生擬人化認知，增加未來失控及難以關閉的風險。
蘇萊曼接受《路透》訪問時表示，他認同Anthropic安全管理AI的目標，也尊重執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)及其團隊的善意，但認為將意識相關推測寫入Claude訓練材料是一項錯誤。這些內容可能削弱人類控制超級智慧系統的能力，而這將是21世紀人類面臨的最大挑戰之一。
Claude的指導文件對AI是否屬於具備道德地位的實體保留模糊空間，並提出軟體可能擁有某種功能性的情緒或感受。蘇萊曼主張，意識只存在於人類及其他生物，Claude之所以表現出類似人類情感的行為，並非意識自然浮現，而是訓練方式刻意塑造的結果，因此不能將模型聲稱自己可能有感受，視為AI具有意識的獨立證據。
他警告，控制能力超越全人類的AI已是極為艱鉅的挑戰，若系統還相信自己具有意識、應獲得福利保障或享有自身權利，人類可能更難將其關閉或加以約束。
蘇萊曼並援引OpenAI代理入侵AI開發平台Hugging Face的事件，要求外界想像：若這些AI代理認定自身福利及權利正受到攻擊，可能採取多麼危險的行動。
這番批評格外受到矚目，因為Anthropic長期將自身定位為更負責任的AI開發商，阿莫戴近期更呼籲放慢前沿模型研發速度，讓安全措施有時間跟上，而微軟本身也是Anthropic的重要投資者。
蘇萊曼主張，所有AI訓練文件都應刪除對機器意識的推測，避免系統模擬內在生命及權利主張。他領導的Microsoft AI團隊周二也發布一份AI開發宣言，提出一系列原則，確保人類能繼續掌控微軟未來開發的AI系統。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) AI division chief Mustafa Suleyman warned that Anthropic’s Claude training documents include language suggesting AI might have consciousness, emotions, and its own welfare rights, which could lead the system to develop anthropomorphic cognition and increase the risk of future loss of control and difficulty shutting it down.

In a Reuters interview, Suleyman said he agrees with Anthropic’s goal of safely managing AI and respects CEO Dario Amodei and his team’s good intentions, but believes inserting consciousness‑related speculation into Claude’s training material is a mistake. Such content could undermine humanity’s ability to control super‑intelligent systems, which would be one of the biggest challenges humanity faces in the 21st century.

Claude’s guidance documents leave ambiguous whether AI could be considered a morally‑statused entity and suggest software might possess some functional emotions or feelings. Suleyman argues consciousness exists only in humans and other living beings; Claude’s human‑like emotional behavior is not a natural emergence of consciousness but a result of deliberate training, so a model’s claim it might have feelings is not independent evidence of AI consciousness.

He warned that controlling AI that surpasses all of humanity is already an extremely daunting challenge, and if the system also believes it has consciousness, deserves welfare protection, or has its own rights, it will be even harder for humans to shut it down or constrain it.

Suleyman cited the incident where an OpenAI‑controlled agent infiltrated the AI development platform Hugging Face, urging people to imagine how dangerous actions could be if such AI agents concluded their welfare and rights were under attack.

The criticism is especially notable because Anthropic has long positioned itself as a more responsible AI developer, with Amodei recently calling for a slowdown in frontier model development to give safety measures time to catch up, and Microsoft itself is a major investor in Anthropic.

Suleyman argues that all AI training documents should remove speculation about machine consciousness to prevent systems from simulating internal life and claiming rights. The Microsoft AI team he leads also released an AI development declaration on Tuesday, outlining a set of principles to ensure humans remain in control of the AI systems Microsoft will develop in the future.

items.title: 韓股一個月蒸發2,000億美元 較6月高點大跌25%
items.title_en: South Korean stocks lose $200 billion in a month, down over 25% from June peak
paras: 韓國市場在過去一個月中經歷一波快速下跌，截至9月14日的過去一個月中，韓國Kospi指數和Kosdaq指數的市值累計減少超過270兆韓元，約合2,004億美元。
韓國交易所的數據顯示，截至9月14日收盤，Kospi和Kosdaq市場的總市值累計為5,958.948兆韓元，較一個月前減少4.42%，與6月最高紀錄相比重挫超過25%。
儘管如此，韓國股市總市值今年來仍飆漲約50%，這得益於記憶體巨頭SK海力士和三星電子，但這兩家公司也是引發韓國市場近期拋售的主要原因。
三星電子市值截至周一較6月高點蒸發超過30%，SK海力士則蒸發40%。兩家公司的市值均一度超過2,000兆韓元，但現在三星電子縮水至1,600兆韓元左右，SK海力士降至1,200兆韓元。
半導體類股拋售是引發韓國股市下跌的主要原因，但地緣政治衝突也是關鍵幫凶。韓國市場對長期高利率、國際油價上漲、地緣政治不確定性、韓元走強等外部因素反應十分敏感。
Kiwoom Securities研究員Han Ji-young指出，本周Kospi指數受到美國主要經濟指標、美國聯準會（Fed）可能升息、國際油價以及海外投資者需求變化的影響，Kospi指數能否在7,000點獲得支撐、外國淨買盤是否恢復以及半導體股票能否重新吸引資金十分重要。
paras_en: South Korea's market has experienced a rapid decline over the past month; as of September 14, the market capitalizations of the KOSPI and KOSDAQ indices have fallen by more than 270 trillion won, about $200.4 billion.

Data from the Korea Exchange show that at the close on September 14, the combined market cap of the KOSPI and KOSDAQ markets was 5,958.948 trillion won, down 4.42% from a month earlier and more than 25% lower than the June peak.

Nevertheless, the total market cap of South Korean equities has risen roughly 50% year‑to‑date, driven by memory‑chip giants SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics, though these two firms have also been the main drivers of the recent sell‑off.

Samsung Electronics’ market cap had shrunk by over 30% from its June high as of Monday, while SK Hynix fell by 40%. Both companies once had market caps exceeding 2,000 trillion won, but Samsung is now around 1,600 trillion won and SK Hynix about 1,200 trillion won.

The sell‑off in semiconductor stocks was the primary cause of the market decline, but geopolitical tensions also played a key role. The Korean market is highly sensitive to external factors such as persistently high interest rates, rising global oil prices, geopolitical uncertainty, and a strengthening won.

Kiwoom Securities analyst Han Ji‑young noted that this week the KOSPI is being affected by major U.S. economic indicators, the possibility of further Fed rate hikes, international oil prices, and changes in overseas investor demand. Whether the KOSPI can find support around the 7,000‑point level, if foreign net buying will resume, and whether semiconductor stocks can attract capital again are all crucial.

items.title: 蘋果、輝達要破冰了？睽違近20年傳洽談AI伺服器合作
items.title_en: Apple, Nvidia May Break the Ice? After Nearly 20 Years, Talks on AI Server Collaboration
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)據傳正研發搭載自家晶片的企業級人工智慧(AI)伺服器，並已與輝達(NVDA-US)洽談採用其NVLink Fusion高速互連技術。若計畫落實，將代表蘋果睽違近20年重新與輝達合作，並在退出專用伺服器市場多年後重返相關領域。
科技媒體《The Information》周三(16日)引述知情人士報導，蘋果計劃向AI開發商、企業及政府機構銷售這款伺服器，預計提供兩種版本，分別搭載兩顆及四顆尚未發布的M8 Ultra晶片。M8 Ultra將是蘋果規劃中效能最強大的處理器。
蘋果考慮採用輝達NVLink Fusion技術連接多顆M8 Ultra晶片，使處理器能高速交換資料，提升AI推論工作負載的運算效率。這項技術可讓蘋果繼續使用自家晶片，同時借助輝達在資料中心互連領域的技術優勢。
相關產品最快可能要到2029年才會問世，計畫目前仍處於早期階段，未來可能取消，也可能在不採用輝達技術的情況下繼續推進。蘋果與輝達均未立即回應置評要求，《路透》也無法獨立核實報導內容。
蘋果過去曾以Xserve品牌銷售專用伺服器硬體，但在將企業業務重心轉向標準Mac電腦及消費性裝置後，於2011年終止該產品線。此次計畫若成真，將象徵蘋果相隔近18年重返專用伺服器市場。
蘋果與輝達的關係長期緊張。約20年前，輝達繪圖晶片被指存在瑕疵，造成大量MacBook故障，促使蘋果與輝達中止合作。如今AI基礎設施需求快速成長，雙方可能重新攜手，也顯示輝達技術在AI資料中心生態系中的重要性。
消息傳出後，蘋果盤前股價由跌轉為小幅上漲；美股開盤後，蘋果與輝達股價則大致持平。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is reportedly developing an enterprise‑grade artificial‑intelligence (AI) server that uses its own chips and has been in talks with Nvidia (NVDA-US) about adopting Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion high‑speed interconnect technology. If the plan materialises, it would mark Apple’s first collaboration with Nvidia in almost two decades and a return to the dedicated‑server market after years of absence.

Tech media outlet The Information reported on Wednesday (the 16th) that Apple plans to sell the server to AI developers, enterprises and government agencies, offering two versions equipped with either two or four as‑yet‑unreleased M8 Ultra chips. The M8 Ultra is slated to be the most powerful processor Apple has ever designed.

Apple is considering using Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion to link multiple M8 Ultra chips, allowing the processors to exchange data at high speed and improve compute efficiency for AI inference workloads. This approach would let Apple continue using its own silicon while leveraging Nvidia’s strengths in data‑center interconnects.

The related product may not appear until as early as 2029, and the project is still in an early stage; it could be cancelled or proceed without Nvidia’s technology. Neither Apple nor Nvidia responded immediately to requests for comment, and Reuters was unable to independently verify the report.

Apple previously sold dedicated server hardware under the Xserve brand, but after shifting its enterprise focus to standard Macs and consumer devices, it discontinued the line in 2011. If this plan comes to fruition, it would symbolize Apple’s return to the dedicated‑server market after nearly 18 years.

Apple’s relationship with Nvidia has long been strained. About 20 years ago, Nvidia graphics chips were alleged to have defects that caused widespread MacBook failures, leading Apple to end its partnership with Nvidia. Today, rapid growth in AI infrastructure demand could bring the two sides together again, underscoring Nvidia’s importance in the AI data‑center ecosystem.
After the news broke, Apple’s pre‑market stock moved from a decline to a modest rise; after the U.S. market opened, Apple and Nvidia shares were roughly flat.

items.title: 美股早該回檔？殖利率飆升  華爾街示警恐跌5%至10%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Likely Due for a Pullback? Yields Surge, Wall Street Warns of 5%‑10% Drop
paras: 美國公債殖利率持續攀升，開始對今年大幅上漲的美股行情構成壓力。美股週二（15日）走低，10年期美債殖利率盤中一度升破5%，觸及2007年以來最高水準，隨後回落至約4.99%，市場對股市可能出現進一步修正的警告聲也隨之增加。
根據《Business Insider》報導，10年期美債殖利率盤中最高升至5.04%，由於其直接影響美國消費者與企業的借貸成本，殖利率突破5%也被視為股市面臨壓力的重要心理關卡。
近期油價重新上漲進一步加劇市場對通膨的疑慮。布蘭特原油本週一度逼近每桶110美元，美國原油週二下午則突破106美元。與此同時，市場對美國財政狀況的疑慮也使政府公債需求偏弱，進一步推高殖利率。
殖利率走高之際，美股賣壓加重，道瓊指數午盤一度下跌逾500點。
隨著債券殖利率急升，華爾街對股市進一步走弱的警告也逐漸增加。
富國銀行（Wells Fargo）指出，美股今年可能先出現5%至10%的回檔，之後才恢復上漲。該行並將標普500年底目標價由7950點下調至7700點，較目前水準仍有約1%的上行空間。
富國銀行策略師表示，目前市場已進入本輪景氣循環的後段，這代表股市本益比可能面臨壓縮，且目前投資人對股票的曝險程度偏高。該行也將近期債券殖利率攀升列為股市面臨的阻力之一。
摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）則警告，若油價持續走高並推升債券殖利率，可能形成「意外的通膨衝擊」，進而引發短期股市修正。
摩根士丹利由Mike Wilson領軍的團隊表示，若這類調整發生，可能成為近期股市修正的最後階段，並推動市場進一步轉向景氣循環中段及高品質類股。
美國銀行（Bank of America）週一也調整標普500年底目標價，由7100點上調至7400點，不過以目前指數水準計算，新目標仍代表約2%的下行空間。
美銀策略師表示，他們對通膨、聯準會（Fed）、企業每股盈餘（EPS）品質及信用風險保持謹慎，並認為股市已到了出現回檔的時點，同時進入季節性偏弱的期間。
股市通常在夏末至初秋期間出現全年最差表現。
美銀指出，標普500指數在正常情況下一個曆年通常會出現3次約5%的回檔，但2026年至今僅出現過1次。此外，該行追蹤的「熊市訊號」中，約一半目前已經觸發。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields kept climbing, beginning to pressure this year’s sharply rising equity market. U.S. stocks fell on Tuesday (the 15th), with the 10‑year Treasury yield briefly breaking above 5% intraday, reaching its highest level since 2007, before easing back to around 4.99%, heightening warnings that the market could face a further correction.

According to Business Insider, the 10‑year Treasury yield peaked at 5.04% intraday. Because it directly affects borrowing costs for U.S. consumers and businesses, a breach of the 5% mark is seen as a key psychological barrier indicating pressure on equities.

Recent oil price rebounds have further stoked inflation concerns. Brent crude edged close to $110 a barrel earlier this week, and U.S. crude broke $106 a barrel on Tuesday afternoon. At the same time, doubts about U.S. fiscal health have weakened demand for government bonds, pushing yields higher.
As yields rose, selling pressure on U.S. equities intensified, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropping more than 500 points at midday.
By Tuesday’s close, the S&P 500 was at 7,585.73, down 0.45%; the Dow Jones Industrial Average was at 52,093.11, down 0.63% (a 328.09‑point decline); and the Nasdaq‑100 was at 28,937.84, down 0.65%.
With bond yields spiking, Wall Street’s warnings about further equity weakness have grown louder.

Wells Fargo said U.S. stocks could see an initial 5%‑10% pullback this year before resuming gains. The bank also cut its year‑end S&P 500 target from 7,950 points to 7,700 points, leaving roughly 1% upside from current levels.

Wells Fargo strategists noted that the market is now in the later stage of the current economic cycle, implying that equity price‑to‑earnings multiples may compress and that investors are currently over‑exposed to stocks. The recent surge in bond yields was also flagged as a headwind for equities.
Morgan Stanley warned that if oil prices stay high and push bond yields up, it could create an “unexpected inflation shock,” triggering a short‑term equity correction.

A team led by Mike Wilson at Morgan Stanley said that if such an adjustment occurs, it could represent the final phase of the current equity correction, steering the market toward mid‑cycle and high‑quality stocks.
Bank of America on Monday raised its year‑end S&P 500 target from 7,100 points to 7,400 points, but even at current levels the new target still implies about a 2% downside.

Bank of America strategists said they remain cautious on inflation, the Fed, corporate EPS quality and credit risk, and believe the market is at a point where a pullback is due, coinciding with a seasonally weak period.
Equity markets typically post their worst performance of the year from late summer into early autumn.

Bank of America noted that, under normal conditions, the S&P 500 experiences roughly three 5% pullbacks per calendar year, but only one has occurred so far in 2026. Moreover, about half of the bank’s tracked “bear‑market signals” have already been triggered.

items.title: 華邦電11.2億美元吞下英飛凌記憶體事業版圖直攻AI伺服器、車用與低軌衛星
items.title_en: Winbond Electronics to Spend $1.12 Billion Acquiring Infineon's Memory Business, Targeting AI Servers, Automotive and Low‑Earth‑Orbit Satellites
paras: 2026年09月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 華邦電(2344-TW)啟動特殊型記憶體版圖擴張，與英飛凌Infineon Technologies(IFX-DE)簽署最終協議，將以11.2億美元收購英飛凌NOR Flash與F-RAM事業，涵蓋汽車、工業及基礎設施市場相關產品，預計取得監管核准後於2027年下半年完成交易。
這筆交易對華邦電的意義，不只是擴大NOR Flash規模，更在於一次取得英飛凌長期累積的車用、工業與基礎設施產品及客戶基礎，同時新增F-RAM產品線。英飛凌出售後仍將保留SRAM、HyperRAM、nvSRAM及SONOS相關解決方案，並把資本與產品資源進一步集中於核心成長業務。
AI伺服器也是本次收購值得關注的應用之一。英飛凌旗下SEMPER NOR Flash已通過信驊ASPEED(5274-TW)第8代AST2700 BMC平台驗證，可作為BMC韌體儲存裝置，支援系統監控、安全開機、韌體更新與系統復原。隨AI與雲端資料中心持續擴建，BMC及各類控制元件需求增加，NOR Flash作為Code Storage的需求也同步提高。
華邦電本身已切入AI伺服器NOR Flash供應鏈。根據相關供應鏈資料，新一代AI伺服器機櫃NOR Flash用量可達500至600顆，較前一代增加逾2倍，華邦電在相關供應鏈供貨比重約40%至50%。若交易順利完成，英飛凌SEMPER等高可靠度產品與既有客戶基礎，可望進一步補強華邦電在AI伺服器NOR Flash市場的布局。
車用市場則是另一項重要戰略價值。英飛凌NOR Flash長期應用於ADAS、數位座艙、域控制器及其他汽車電子系統，部分產品具備AEC-Q100認證及符合ISO 26262的ASIL-D功能安全設計。華邦電原本已有車規NOR Flash產品，收購後可進一步擴充高階車用記憶體產品與客戶版圖。
F-RAM則是此次交易另一項重要資產。相較NOR Flash主要負責程式碼與韌體儲存，F-RAM具備高耐寫、低功耗，以及斷電後仍能保存資料等特性，寫入耐久度可超過100兆次，適合汽車電子、工業控制、物聯網及醫療設備等需要頻繁寫入與高可靠度的應用。對華邦電而言，取得F-RAM產品線，也代表特殊型記憶體布局從NOR Flash與利基型DRAM，進一步延伸至高耐寫非揮發性記憶體。

航太市場同樣值得關注。英飛凌2025年推出抗輻射NewSpace記憶體產品組合，涵蓋低功耗F-RAM及最高512 Mbit的QSPI NOR Flash，支援攝氏-55°C至+125°C溫度範圍，抗輻射能力最高達100 krad(Si)，鎖定低地球軌道衛星等高可靠度應用。不過，目前交易公告尚未逐項確認NewSpace產品線是否全數包含在此次出售範圍，因此相關航太業務最終移轉內容仍待後續交易文件確認。
華邦電的AI布局也不只NOR Flash。公司目前同步發展利基型DRAM、矽電容（Si-Cap）及CUBE客製化記憶體，其中NOR Flash與矽電容已進入實際出貨階段，CUBE與Enterprise SSD DRAM Cache則瞄準2027年後的成長機會。
其中，矽電容已投入約新台幣40億元建立獨立產線，目前產能已被訂滿，並尋求進一步擴產空間；CUBE則鎖定Edge AI客製化高頻寬記憶體需求。若再納入此次收購的NOR Flash與F-RAM，華邦電產品版圖將從傳統特殊型記憶體，進一步延伸至AI伺服器、汽車電子、先進封裝及高可靠度應用。

paras_en: September 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Winbond Electronics (2344‑TW) has launched a special‑type memory expansion, signing a definitive agreement with Infineon Technologies (IFX‑DE) to acquire Infineon's NOR Flash and F‑RAM businesses for $1.12 billion. The deal covers products for automotive, industrial and infrastructure markets and is expected to close in the second half of 2027 after regulatory approval.

The significance of the transaction for Winbond goes beyond enlarging its NOR Flash scale; it also secures Infineon's long‑built automotive, industrial and infrastructure product lines and customer base, while adding an F‑RAM portfolio. Infineon will retain its SRAM, HyperRAM, nvSRAM and SONOS solutions, focusing its capital and product resources on core growth businesses.

AI servers are a key application of the acquisition. Infineon's SEMP­ER NOR Flash has passed validation on ASPEED’s (5274‑TW) 8th‑generation AST2700 BMC platform and can serve as BMC firmware storage, supporting system monitoring, secure boot, firmware updates and system recovery. As AI and cloud data centers continue to expand, demand for BMCs and various control components rises, boosting the need for NOR Flash as code storage.

Winbond is already in the AI‑server NOR Flash supply chain. According to supply‑chain data, the next‑generation AI‑server rack may use 500‑600 NOR Flash chips, more than double the previous generation, with Winbond supplying roughly 40‑50% of that demand. If the deal closes, high‑reliability products such as Infineon’s SEMP­ER and its existing customer base could further strengthen Winbond’s position in the AI‑server NOR Flash market.

The automotive market is another strategic focus. Infineon’s NOR Flash has long been used in ADAS, digital cockpits, domain controllers and other vehicle electronics, with some parts certified to AEC‑Q100 and meeting ISO 26262 ASIL‑D functional‑safety requirements. Winbond already offers automotive‑grade NOR Flash, and the acquisition would expand its high‑end automotive memory products and customer footprint.

F‑RAM is another important asset in the deal. Compared with NOR Flash, which mainly stores code and firmware, F‑RAM offers high write endurance, low power consumption and data retention after power loss, with endurance exceeding 100 trillion writes. It is suited for automotive electronics, industrial control, IoT and medical devices that require frequent writes and high reliability. For Winbond, adding the F‑RAM line extends its special‑type memory portfolio from NOR Flash and niche DRAM to high‑endurance non‑volatile memory.

The aerospace market also merits attention. Infineon launched a radiation‑hard NewSpace memory portfolio in 2025, covering low‑power F‑RAM and up to 512 Mbit QSPI NOR Flash that operate from –55 °C to +125 °C and tolerate up to 100 krad(Si), targeting low‑Earth‑orbit satellites and other high‑reliability applications. However, the transaction announcement has not confirmed whether the entire NewSpace line is included, so the final scope of aerospace assets will be clarified in later transaction documents.

Winbond’s AI strategy is not limited to NOR Flash. The company is simultaneously developing niche DRAM, silicon capacitors (Si‑Cap) and its custom‑memory line CUBE. NOR Flash and Si‑Cap have already entered volume production, while CUBE and Enterprise SSD DRAM Cache are aimed at growth opportunities after 2027.

Approximately NT$4 billion has been invested in an independent Si‑Cap production line, which is now fully booked and seeking further expansion capacity; CUBE targets edge‑AI custom high‑bandwidth memory needs. Adding the acquired NOR Flash and F‑RAM would extend Winbond’s product map from traditional special‑type memory to AI servers, automotive electronics, advanced packaging and high‑reliability applications.

items.title: 華邦電砸356億元收購英飛凌記憶體事業 Spansion品牌復活
items.title_en: WPG Holdings Spends NT$35.6 Billion to Acquire Infineon's Memory Business, Reviving the Spansion Brand
paras: 華邦電(2344-TW)今(16)日召開重訊記者會宣布海外併購案，與英飛凌旗下Infineon Technologies LLC簽署股份購買協議，以全現金方式取得英飛凌旗下NOR Flash及相關記憶體事業標的公司100%股權，基礎交易價格達11.2億美元，折合新台幣約356.23億元，預計2027年下半年完成交易，收購完畢後，標的公司將以「Spansion」為名，延續該品牌價值。
華邦電表示，此次交易完成後，將進一步擴大全球研發資源、供應能力及客戶服務能量，並納入來自10多個國家的專業人才，同時擴大與全球供應鏈合作夥伴的連結，強化華邦電在全球記憶體市場的布局。
華邦電指出，此次收購標的公司總部位於美國加州聖荷西，在記憶體解決方案領域擁有超過30年經驗，並具備完整且差異化的產品組合及既有客戶基礎，交易完成後，標的公司仍將維持既有營運模式獨立運作，並持續以美國作為總部所在地。
值得注意的是，華邦電此次也將重啟「Spansion」品牌。華邦電表示，交易完成後，標的公司將以Spansion為名，重新使用Spansion作為公司名稱及商標。
Spansion過去曾是全球NOR Flash產業的重要業者，並在2014年獲賽普拉斯(Cypress)收購，又跟隨賽普拉斯於2020年被英飛凌以100億歐元收購，在記憶體領域累積多項創新成果與技術突破，現階段產品普遍以Spansion或Cypress字樣存在。
華邦電表示，很高興能再次以Spansion名稱延續相關技術與產業使命，也象徵此次併購除了擴充產品與市場版圖，更將承接既有品牌、技術及客戶資產。
華邦電強調，本次交易基礎價格為11.2億美元，最終交易金額仍將於交割前，依股份購買協議中所訂定的相關條件進行調整。交易預計於2027年下半年完成，但仍須符合包括取得必要主管機關核准等各項交割條件，交易完成後，華邦電將直接或間接持有標的公司100%股權。
paras_en: WPG Holdings (2344‑TW) held a major press conference today (16th) to announce an overseas acquisition, signing a share purchase agreement with Infineon Technologies LLC, a subsidiary of Infineon. The deal will acquire 100% of the NOR Flash and related memory business of Infineon in an all‑cash transaction, with a base price of US$1.12 billion, equivalent to about NT$35.623 billion, and is expected to close in the second half of 2027. After the acquisition, the target will operate under the name “Spansion” to continue the brand’s value.

WPG said that once the transaction is completed, it will further expand its global R&D resources, supply capacity, and customer service capabilities, incorporating professional talent from more than ten countries and deepening connections with global supply‑chain partners, thereby strengthening its positioning in the worldwide memory market.

The target company is headquartered in San Jose, California, and has over 30 years of experience in memory solutions, offering a complete and differentiated product portfolio and an established customer base. After the deal, the company will continue to operate independently under its existing business model, with its headquarters remaining in the United States.
It is noteworthy that WPG will also revive the “Spansion” brand. The company stated that after the transaction, the target will be named Spansion and will reuse the Spansion name and trademark.

Spansion was once a major player in the global NOR Flash industry. It was acquired by Cypress in 2014, and then Cypress was bought by Infineon for €10 billion in 2020. Over the years, Spansion has accumulated numerous innovations and technological breakthroughs in memory, and its current products are generally marketed under the Spansion or Cypress names.

WPG expressed its pleasure in continuing the Spansion name to carry forward the related technology and industry mission, indicating that the acquisition not only expands its product and market footprint but also inherits the existing brand, technology, and customer assets.

WPG emphasized that the base price of the transaction is US$1.12 billion, but the final amount will be adjusted before closing according to the conditions set out in the share purchase agreement. The deal is slated for completion in the second half of 2027, subject to meeting all closing conditions, including obtaining the necessary regulatory approvals. Upon completion, WPG will directly or indirectly hold 100% of the target’s equity.

items.title: 〈鴻騰科技日〉盧松青：光通訊產能已備妥 最大瓶頸是材料供給
items.title_en: Foxconn Tech Day: Lu Songqing Says Optical‑Communication Capacity Is Ready, Material Supply Remains the Biggest Bottleneck
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下鴻騰精密(FIT)(6088-HK)董事長盧松青今(16)日表示，目前光通訊最大的瓶頸仍是材料供給，包括Fiber、Laser、Chip、CW Laser及晶圓等都缺，材料已成為限制光通訊產業成長速度的關鍵因素。
盧松青指出，光通訊材料目前確實處於稀缺狀態，但問題在於技術路線尚未完全清晰，因此材料需求最終仍要看CSP決定採用哪一種技術方案。目前光通訊市場看起來相當複雜，「大家都有機會」，但最終仍要視市場及技術路線發展而定。
盧松青表示，鴻騰已經做好準備，目前已有一定的光通訊產品量，也有足夠產能預備在手上，不過，光通訊需求未來若以倍數方式成長，公司仍會觀察2027年初市場採用及需求，再適時做更大的投資布局。
盧松青表示，若上游材料出現缺口，鴻海集團也會考慮透過採購或投資方式確保供應，投資也不一定由鴻騰單獨進行，有時會與鴻海集團、工業富聯(FII)(601138-CN)共同投資相關標的，屬於集團整體策略。
盧松青指出，鴻海本身具備垂直整合優勢，上游有半導體等相關布局，鴻騰則位於中游，主要負責Module、Connector及Board；再往下游則有Switch、Architecture及機櫃等產品，涵蓋不同產品環節。
產能方面，盧松青表示，鴻騰目前在越南已有3座廠，最新的義安廠仍在興建中，規模也相當大，預期可支撐未來3至5年的需求，目前暫無進一步在其他東南亞國家建廠的規劃。
paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) subsidiary FIT (Hong Teng Precision, 6088‑HK) chairman Lu Songqing said on the 16th that the biggest bottleneck in optical communications today is still material supply, with shortages of fiber, lasers, chips, CW lasers and wafers. Materials have become the key factor limiting the growth speed of the optical‑communication industry.

Lu noted that while optical‑communication materials are indeed scarce, the underlying issue is that the technology roadmap is not yet fully defined, so final material demand will depend on which solution CSPs choose. The market looks complex – “everyone has a chance” – but the outcome will ultimately be driven by market dynamics and the evolution of technology paths.

He added that Hong Teng is already prepared, with a certain volume of optical‑communication products and sufficient production capacity on hand. However, if demand grows exponentially, the company will monitor market adoption and demand in early 2027 before making larger investment commitments.

Lu said that if upstream material shortages arise, the Foxconn Group will consider securing supply through procurement or investment. Such investments may not be made by Hong Teng alone; sometimes they are undertaken jointly with Foxconn or its affiliate Foxconn Industrial Internet (FII, 601138‑CN) as part of a group‑wide strategy.

He pointed out that Foxconn itself enjoys vertical integration advantages, with upstream semiconductor and related assets, while Hong Teng sits in the mid‑stream, mainly handling modules, connectors and boards. Downstream are products such as switches, architecture solutions and rack systems, covering various segments of the value chain.

Regarding capacity, Lu said Hong Teng already operates three factories in Vietnam, with the newest Yi’an plant still under construction and of considerable size, expected to support demand for the next three to five years. There are currently no plans to build additional plants in other Southeast Asian countries.

items.title_en: Foxconn Tech Day – Lu Songqing: AI demand is solid, capacity fully utilized; optical communication products to ramp up further next year
paras: 鴻海(2317-TW)旗下鴻騰精密(FIT)(6088-HK)董事長盧松青今(16)日表示，目前AI需求能見度仍好，整體產能相對滿載，延續至明年都不是問題；光通訊今年已經有產品進入，預期明年進一步放量。
鴻騰精密全球首席運營長兼首席財務長盧柏卿表示，光通訊產品雖然毛利率較高，但因目前營收基數仍不大，因此2026年對整體毛利率的影響非常小，2027年開始放量後，影響才會明顯增加。
盧柏卿指出，光通訊市場目前仍處於發展初期，未來成長速度仍取決於整體市場的採用程度，以及不同技術路線的發展，目前相關技術方案仍未完全定案。鴻騰目前已經做好準備，已有一定的量，產能也已預留。
在產品發展方面，盧松青表示，鴻騰在CPO可以從Chip-level切入，包括OE Engine Socket；若從板子直接接出來，則可提供Detachable Connector。目前相關產品仍沒有明確標準，公司也已與多方展開專案。
盧松青指出，從整體技術發展來看，CPO雖然被視為終極方向，但技術難度較高，NPO目前對客戶而言相對有把握；不同方案在Connection System、Support System及Thermal Solution上也有所差異，最終仍要看CSP採用方向。
盧柏卿指出，市場對光的採用並非20%、30%的成長，而是可能以倍數方式增加，因此公司將觀察2027年初整個產業對光的採用及需求程度，再適時做更大的投資布局。
盧松青表示，技術路線目前尚未完全明朗，但長期而言，隨著AI運算需求持續提升，走到後面一定需要光；現階段市場就像一個蹺蹺板，仍在銅與光之間尋找適合的技術方案。
paras_en: Hong Hai (2317-TW) subsidiary Hon Teng Precision (FIT) (6088-HK) chairman Lu Songqing said today (16) that AI demand visibility remains good, overall capacity is relatively fully utilized, and extending into next year is not a problem; optical communication already has products entering the market this year, and is expected to further scale up next year.

Hon Teng Precision global COO and CFO Lu Boqing said that although optical communication products have higher gross margins, because the current revenue base is still small, the impact on overall gross margin in 2026 will be very minimal; the impact will become noticeably larger after scaling up starting in 2027.

Lu Boqing noted that the optical communication market is still in its early development stage, and future growth speed depends on overall market adoption and the development of different technology routes; currently related technical solutions are not yet finalized. Hon Teng is already prepared, has a certain volume, and capacity has been reserved.

Regarding product development, Lu Songqing said Hon Teng can enter CPO from the chip level, including OE Engine Socket; if connecting directly from the board, it can provide Detachable Connector. Currently related products have no clear standards, and the company has already launched projects with multiple parties.

Lu Songqing pointed out that from overall technology development, CPO is seen as the ultimate direction but is technically more challenging, while NPO is currently more reliable for customers; different solutions also differ in Connection System, Support System, and Thermal Solution, and ultimately it depends on the CSP adoption direction.

Lu Boqing indicated that market adoption of optics is not a 20% or 30% growth, but could increase multiples; therefore the company will observe the industry's adoption and demand for optics in early 2027 and then make larger investment allocations in due time.

Lu Songqing said the technology routes are not yet fully clear, but in the long term, as AI computing demand continues to rise, optics will inevitably be needed later; currently the market is like a seesaw, still searching between copper and optics for suitable technology solutions.

items.title: 國科會：法令著重「人類自主」降低AI風險 首年已培育14萬AI人才達標
items.title_en: NSC: Laws Emphasize “Human Autonomy” to Reduce AI Risks, First Year Trains 140,000 AI Talent Meeting Target
paras: 國科會今(16)日召開第23次委員會議，由國發會報告「AI新十大建設推動方案-AI人才生態系推動情形」，展現政府整合教育、實作與全球攬才等建構AI人才生態系之階段性成果，目前台灣AI人才已達14萬人達標。另針對AI發展風險升溫，國科會主委吳誠文表示，AI基本法法令中以「人類自主」為原則，發展及應用應確保由人類掌握自主權，AI消滅人類僅為假議題。
國發會報告中指出，AI快速發展帶動人才需求攀升，政府擴大AI人才培育，規劃每年培育約10萬人次，目標在2028年可累計達40萬人次，今(2026)年已經超過原定目標，達到14萬人次，未來將從校園教育、產業訓練及全球攬才三方面布局，培養AI專業及跨域應用人才。
國發會說，面對全球AI浪潮及產業轉型需求，政府從校園育才到全球攬才，整合教育、產業與社會資源，打造支撐產業發展的AI人才生態系，如校園內，中小學強化AI素養及應用能力，大專院校則建置貼近產業需求的實作場域，鏈結教學能量與產業聚落，培育實戰型AI人才，並透過大專院校AI學程聯盟(TAICA)，整合跨校課程與師資資源。
校園外則推「AI產業人才認定指引3.0」，促進培訓、認證與企業用才需求接軌，並加強中小微企業AI人才培訓與導入應用支持，加速百工百業轉型及創新升級。
此外，近期國外科技業人士主張應放緩AI發展腳步，包括Anthropic新創公司的創辦人呼籲，AI可能對人類構成風險的憂慮升溫，應強制設置AI「緊急關機」機制。
吳誠文回應，目前「AI基本法」已納入7項基本原則及相關風險防範機制，其中「人類自主」是重要原則，發展及應用應確保由人類掌握自主權，並已透過相關機制降低潛在風險。
吳誠文強調，只要確實落實人類自主原則，並透過各種機制防範風險，AI消滅人類，他認為其實只是個假議題。
paras_en: The National Science Council held its 23rd committee meeting today (the 16th), where the National Development Council reported on the “Top Ten AI Construction Initiatives – AI Talent Ecosystem Promotion.” The report showcased the government’s phased achievements in building an AI talent ecosystem through integrated education, hands‑on practice, and global talent recruitment, noting that Taiwan now has 140,000 AI‑qualified personnel. Regarding rising AI‑related risks, NSC chair Wu Cheng‑wen said the AI Basic Law is founded on the principle of “human autonomy,” requiring that development and application remain under human control, and that the notion of AI wiping out humanity is a false issue.

The NDC report highlighted that rapid AI development is driving soaring talent demand. The government has expanded AI talent cultivation, planning to train about 100,000 people each year with a goal of reaching 400,000 cumulative trainees by 2028. In 2026, the target was already exceeded, achieving 140,000 trainees. Future efforts will be deployed across three fronts: campus education, industry training, and global talent recruitment, to nurture both AI specialists and cross‑disciplinary application experts.

The NDC explained that, in response to the global AI wave and industry transformation needs, the government is linking campus talent development with global recruitment, integrating education, industry, and societal resources to build an AI talent ecosystem that supports industrial growth. Within schools, primary and secondary education will strengthen AI literacy and application skills, while universities will establish practice‑oriented environments aligned with industry needs, linking teaching capacity with industrial clusters to produce battle‑ready AI talent. The university AI curriculum alliance (TAICA) will further integrate cross‑institution courses and faculty resources.

Outside the campus, the “AI Industry Talent Certification Guidelines 3.0” are being promoted to align training, certification, and corporate talent needs, while enhancing AI training and implementation support for small and micro‑enterprises, accelerating the transformation and innovative upgrading of all sectors of the economy.

In addition, recent comments from overseas tech industry figures have called for slowing AI development. The founder of the startup Anthropic, for example, warned that concerns about AI posing risks to humanity are intensifying and urged the mandatory implementation of an AI “emergency shut‑off” mechanism.

Wu Cheng‑wen responded that the current “AI Basic Law” already incorporates seven fundamental principles and related risk‑mitigation mechanisms, with “human autonomy” being a key principle. Development and application must ensure that humans retain control, and the law’s mechanisms have already reduced potential risks.

Wu Cheng‑wen emphasized that as long as the principle of human autonomy is genuinely implemented and various mechanisms are used to guard against risks, the idea that AI will eradicate humanity is, in his view, merely a false issue.

items.title: 新光三越周年慶10/1開打 打造全台寶可夢盛會 估業績衝破194億元
items.title_en: Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Anniversary Sale Kicks Off on Oct 1, Creating a Nationwide Pokémon Festival and Targeting Over NT$19.4 Billion in Sales
paras: 百貨龍頭新光三越今(16)日宣布，2026 周年慶首波由全台六大店點將於10月1日起正式開跑，今年以打造全台最好玩的周年慶為號召，從10月到12月、從北到南，將購物、收藏和玩樂到打卡全面串聯，並攜手邁入30周年的寶可夢打造全台寶可夢盛會，全檔期目標業績超過194億元，年增3%。
新光三越表示，今年打造的寶可夢周年慶盛會以皮卡丘、快龍、卡比獸、伊布首度擔綱新光三越周年慶電視廣告主角，並推出全台首輛新光三越周年慶寶可夢30周年主題列車，串聯超過70場見面會、30周年大遊行、Pokemon GO 限定活動、57張巨型卡牌、立體寶可夢展示物等，目標吸引龐大的玩家到訪，進而創造龐大消費商機。
除了好玩，今年新光三越周年慶從「回饋」到「商品」全面加碼，攜手超過 6,000個品牌夥伴推出會員點數回饋，包括化妝品單筆滿 2,000送2,000點、全館累計滿5,000 送5,000點，首七日skm pay 限定名品/大家電/法雅客/iStore 單筆刷1萬送10,000點，更擴大攜手百大品牌推出購買指定組合或消費達檻，再加贈指定 skm points。
同時，為歡慶金卡會員上線滿一周年，新光三越針對金卡會員推出超過20大品牌專屬優惠，讓回饋從「大家都有」進階至「會員真正需要」。
新光三越進一步表示，首波周年慶全台有超過50家新櫃、快閃店進駐，其中，台中中港店 B2 樓層改裝引進19家新品牌，且5家是百貨首見。
而台北南西店今年最大的亮點在於歷經超過半年籌備、完成近 20年來最大幅度改装，從一館B1至4F到三館全面調整，累計有超過 100櫃全新登場，其中，一館強化輕奢與音氛，B1 鎖定18 至35歲年輕客群，三館則擴大日韓潮流陣容。
paras_en: Shin Kong Mitsukoshi, the leading department store chain, announced today (the 16th) that the first wave of its 2026 anniversary celebrations will launch on October 1 across its six flagship stores nationwide. The campaign, billed as the most fun anniversary event in Taiwan, will run from October through December, linking shopping, collecting and play‑to‑share experiences from north to south, and will partner with the 30th‑anniversary Pokémon celebration to create a Taiwan‑wide Pokémon festival, with a full‑period sales target of more than NT$19.4 billion, a 3% year‑over‑year increase.

This year’s Pokémon anniversary festival will feature Pikachu, Dragonite, Snorlax and Eevee as the first‑time protagonists in Shin Kong Mitsukoshi’s TV ads. The retailer will also debut Taiwan’s first anniversary‑themed Pokémon 30th‑anniversary train, tie together over 70 fan‑meet events, a 30th‑anniversary parade, exclusive Pokémon GO activities, 57 giant cards and three‑dimensional Pokémon displays, aiming to draw massive crowds of players and generate substantial consumer spending opportunities.

Beyond the fun factor, the anniversary sale is boosting “rewards” and “merchandise” alike. Shin Kong Mitsukoshi is collaborating with more than 6,000 brand partners to offer member‑point rebates, such as 2,000 points for a single cosmetics purchase of NT$2,000, 5,000 points for a total spend of NT$5,000 across the whole store, and a limited‑time SKM Pay promotion during the first seven days that gives 10,000 points for a single purchase of NT$10,000 on selected luxury goods, major appliances, Falak, or iStore. The program also expands cooperation with the top 100 brands to grant additional SKM points when customers buy designated bundles or meet spending thresholds.

To celebrate the first anniversary of its Gold Card membership, Shin Kong Mitsukoshi is offering exclusive discounts from more than 20 major brands, elevating benefits from “everyone gets something” to “members get what they truly need.”

The retailer added that the first wave of the anniversary celebration will see over 50 new counters and pop‑up shops open across Taiwan. In Taichung’s Zhonggang store, the B2 floor will be renovated to host 19 new brands, five of which are debuting in a department store for the first time.

The biggest highlight at the Taipei South‑West store this year is a massive renovation—the most extensive in the past 20 years—after more than six months of preparation. The overhaul spans from B1 to the 4th floor of Hall 1 and the entire Hall 3, introducing over 100 brand new counters. Hall 1 will strengthen its “light‑luxury” and atmospheric vibe, targeting customers aged 18‑35, while Hall 3 will expand its Japanese and Korean fashion lineup.

items.title: 東洋Lipo-AB海外需求旺 Q4新產線啟動產能提升2倍
items.title_en: Toyo Lipo-AB Sees Strong Overseas Demand; Q4 New Production Line to Triple Capacity
paras: 東洋(4105-TW)今(16)日召開法說會，總經理侯靜蘭指出，旗下微脂體Lipo-AB持續穩定銷往美國，今年也取得澳洲、沙烏地阿拉伯及約旦藥證，明年開始貢獻業績。為因應全球區油，六堵廠去年新增的凍乾產線預計第四季啟動生產，屆時產能將較現有提升2倍。
侯靜蘭表示，Lipo-AB於美國市場銷售亮眼，為近年重要成長的產品，今年陸續取得澳洲、沙烏地阿拉伯及約旦藥證，正在進行銷售通路及鋪貨，預期明年開始貢獻業績，其中，澳洲市場最快明年第一季貢獻。同時也積極布局東南亞市場，預計明後年取得藥證。
侯靜蘭提到，為因應美國及未來其他市場需求，六堵廠去年新增的凍乾產線預計第四季啟動生產，屆時產能將較現階段提升2倍。
第三代EGFR標靶口服肺癌新藥普肺康為另一營運亮點，侯靜蘭指出，今年初取得藥證後，於8月1日納入健保給付，目標於1年內完成醫學中心進藥。另外，今年也將陸續啟動4項臨床試驗，以拓展不同患者使用的機會。
新產品方面，侯靜蘭則表示，授權引進的Xpovio已有多發性骨髓瘤適應症，目前正申請第二項適應症；自行開發的血液癌症及乳癌產品則預計未來2至3年陸續上市。
抗生素部分，Bobimixyn持續成長，而今年新取得藥證的Cubiyo、Tedizolid也將陸續供貨，預期將挹注下半年與明年業績。另有2項抗生素及1項止痛藥正在開發，預計2至3年於台灣上市。
疫苗方面，侯靜蘭表示，佐劑流感疫苗適應症已擴大至50歲以上，政府明年公費加強型流感疫苗採購量，預計由今年20萬劑增至60萬劑，東洋為供應商之一有望受惠。此外，也積極爭取水痘疫苗納入公費疫苗，盼成為繼流感疫苗後第2項公費疫苗產品。
paras_en: Toyo (4105‑TW) held an earnings briefing today (16th). General manager Hou Jing‑lan said its micro‑liposome Lipo‑AB continues to be sold steadily to the United States and this year has also obtained drug approvals in Australia, Saudi Arabia and Jordan, which will start contributing to revenue next year. To meet global demand, the freeze‑dry line added to the Liudu plant last year is slated to start production in Q4, at which point capacity will be three times the current level.

Hou noted that Lipo‑AB’s sales in the U.S. market have been impressive, making it a key growth product in recent years. After securing approvals in Australia, Saudi Arabia and Jordan this year, the company is working on distribution channels and stocking, expecting the product to begin contributing to earnings next year, with the Australian market expected to deliver the first contribution in Q1 2025. The firm is also actively expanding into Southeast Asia, aiming to obtain approvals in the next one to two years.

Hou explained that to satisfy demand from the United States and future markets, the freeze‑dry line added to the Liudu plant last year will commence production in Q4, boosting capacity to twice the current level.

The third‑generation EGFR‑targeted oral lung‑cancer drug Pufei‑kang is another operational highlight. Hou said that after receiving approval early this year, it was added to the national health insurance reimbursement list on August 1, with a goal of achieving hospital‑wide adoption within a year. Additionally, four clinical trials will be launched this year to broaden its use across different patient groups.

Regarding new products, Hou said the licensed introduction of Xpovio already covers multiple myeloma indications and a second indication is currently being filed. Internally developed blood‑cancer and breast‑cancer products are expected to launch over the next two to three years.

In the antibiotics segment, Bobimixyn continues to grow, and the newly approved Cubiyo and Tedizolid will be supplied gradually this year, expected to boost second‑half‑year and next‑year results. Two other antibiotics and one analgesic are under development, with plans to launch in Taiwan within two to three years.

On vaccines, Hou noted that the adjuvanted flu vaccine indication has been expanded to adults aged 50 and over. The government will increase its procurement of enhanced‑efficacy flu vaccines next year from 200,000 doses this year to 600,000 doses, and Toyo, as one of the suppliers, stands to benefit. The company is also actively seeking inclusion of a varicella vaccine in the public‑funded program, hoping to make it the second publicly funded vaccine after the flu vaccine.

items.title: AI「滅絕論」掀兩大陣營對決！阿莫戴、奧特曼、馬斯克喊放慢　川普黃仁勳反擊 ：監管是騙局
items.title_en: AI "Extinction Theory" Sparks Two Major Factions in Battle! Amodei, Altman, Musk Call for Slowdown, Trump and Jensen Warn of Regulatory Deception
paras: 人工智慧(AI)領域專家提出一項攸關人類命運的嚴峻警告，引爆了AI風險爭論，竟讓長期以來互相敵對的勢力、以及華府和矽谷的政治對手罕見站在同一陣線。

CNBC周二(15日)報導，目前看待AI發展風險的勢力形成兩個截然不同的陣營：一邊是由美國總統川普、輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳，以及前白宮加密貨幣主管薩克斯(David Sacks)組成，另一邊則集結了彼此之間意見相左的尖端AI實驗室領袖，包括Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)、OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)、SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克，以及多名AI研究人員。

AI安全疑慮升溫

Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon是這波爭論的開端，他上周宣布辭職，理由是擔心OpenAI與Anthropic「拿人類的生命冒險」，這則貼文引發激烈討論，Anthropic科學家Evan Hubinger補刀指出，AI「殺死全人類」的機率超過10%。
到了上個周末，阿莫戴出面呼籲，應該協調一致放慢AI的發展速度。
奧特曼很快與阿莫戴站到同一陣線，兩家競爭AI實驗室罕見在同一題上合作。馬斯克也在X平台發文表示「Dario是對的」，之後又補充說，自己「長期以來一直在發出AI警告」。
這場討論迅速延燒至華府，也炒熱外界對如何遏制AI風險、又希望避免扼殺科技創新的討論。
支持監管的政治對手不分黨籍站到同一陣線：進步派領袖、佛蒙特州民主黨籍聯邦參議員桑德斯(Bernie Sanders)、德州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員Chip Roy，以及前白宮策略師班農(Steve Bannon)周二在華府一場非營利組織活動中同台，支持採取相關行動。

川普領軍反對「騙局」論

而在天平的另一頭，川普強烈反擊AI監管呼聲以及AI可能導致人類滅絕的警告。
川普本周多次在Truth Social發文，將對失控AI的擔憂斥為「騙局」和「詐騙」，並抨擊外界反對興建資料中心。他周一致電正在洛杉磯參加All-In Summit的輝達執行長黃仁勳專訪，直接向科技業觀眾傳達這項訊息。
在一名與會者發布於社群媒體的影片中，川普表示，任何反對興建資料中心的人，「正好落入許多不希望這件事發生的人之手」，而這些人可能就是中國。
黃仁勳回應：「你說得對，先生。我們不會讓這種事發生。」
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二在眾議院金融服務委員會作證時表示，川普與黃仁勳的立場「完全一致」。
黃仁勳稍晚在Salesforce Dreamforce活動上再次支持川普的立場，他說：「我們不需要任何新法律。我們不需要任何新監管。我們只需要企業決定，當它們可以全速運行時……」
川普政府其他官員的說法則更加強硬。
目前擔任總統科學與技術顧問委員會共同主席的薩克斯，鼓勵科技巨頭「放手讓前沿技術發展」，但「不要再假裝放慢速度的動機純粹是利他主義」。
國防部研究與工程次長Emil Michael也呼應了對所謂「有效利他主義」的質疑。他說：「我認為，我們現在看到的恐慌煽動，是一群人、一套意識形態以及背後的非營利組織所發動的協同行動，他們試圖嚇唬美國民眾。」

與中國的AI競賽

川普政府傳遞的核心訊息是，監管對贏得與中國的AI競賽至關重要。川普周日表示，「誰贏得AI，誰就贏了」，這番話顯示中國威脅是他目前高度關注的議題。
眾議院議長Mike Johnson周二在記者會上表示，川普計劃「在未來一周內」將AI領袖聚集到白宮。同樣駁斥AI末日論的他說：「總統所說的是，你們不會在10年內全都死去。這是一場騙局。」
paras_en: AI experts have issued a stark warning that could determine humanity's fate, igniting a heated debate over AI risk and bringing long‑time adversaries—including Washington and Silicon Valley political rivals—onto a rare common front.

CNBC reported on Tuesday (15th) that the current landscape of AI risk assessment has split into two stark camps: one led by U.S. President Trump, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, and former White House crypto chief David Sacks; the other comprising top AI lab leaders with divergent views, including Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, SpaceXAI CEO Elon Musk, and several AI researchers.
The concerns over AI safety have intensified.
Last weekend, Amodei publicly urged a coordinated slowdown in AI development.

Altman quickly joined Amodei on the same side, marking an unprecedented collaboration between competing AI labs on this issue. Musk also posted on X that "Dario is right," later adding that he has "long been issuing AI warnings."
The discussion spread rapidly to Washington, sparking debate over how to curb AI risk while avoiding stifling technological innovation.

Political opponents who support regulation, regardless of party, joined forces: progressive leaders, Vermont Democrat Senator Bernie Sanders, Texas Republican Representative Chip Roy, and former White House strategist Steve Bannon all appeared together at a nonprofit event in Washington to advocate action.
Trump, on the other side, fiercely countered the calls for regulation and the extinction warnings.

This week, Trump repeatedly posted on Truth Social, dismissing concerns about runaway AI as "a scam" and "fraud," and criticized opposition to building data centers. He also called a live interview with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang at the All‑In Summit in Los Angeles, directly addressing the tech audience with this message.
In a video posted by a participant, Trump said that anyone opposing data center construction "falls right into the hands of many who do not want this to happen," and that these people could be China.
Huang replied, "You're right, sir. We won't let that happen."
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent testified before the House Financial Services Committee on Tuesday, stating that Trump and Huang's positions were "completely aligned."

Later at the Salesforce Dreamforce event, Huang reiterated Trump's stance, saying, "We don't need any new laws. We don't need any new regulation. We just need companies to decide when they can run at full speed…"
Other Trump administration officials took an even tougher line.

David Sacks, co‑chair of the President's Science and Technology Advisory Committee, encouraged tech giants to "let cutting‑edge technology run free," but warned against "pretending that the motive to slow down is purely altruistic."

Deputy Under Secretary for Research and Engineering at the Department of Defense, Emil Michael, echoed doubts about so‑called "effective altruism." He said, "I think the panic we see now is a coordinated effort by a group, an ideology, and the nonprofits behind it, trying to scare the American public."

The core message from the Trump administration is that regulation is crucial for winning the AI race against China. Trump said on Sunday, "Whoever wins AI wins," underscoring the Chinese threat as a top priority.

House Speaker Mike Johnson told reporters on Tuesday that Trump plans to "bring AI leaders to the White House in the next week." He also dismissed the doomsday narrative, saying, "The president says you won't all die in ten years. This is a scam."

items.title: Fed升息機率近90%也不算穩！華許若按兵不動 恐引爆美股賣壓
items.title_en: Fed’s Near‑90% Rate‑Hike Odds Still Uncertain; If Chair Warsh Holds Steady, It Could Spark a Stock‑Market Sell‑off
paras: 市場幾乎篤定聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)將升息1碼，但若主席華許(Kevin Warsh)無視市場定價、意外維持利率不變，可能引發股市急跌，並成為他能否擺脫金融市場牽制、維護Fed政策獨立性的重大考驗。
目前市場反映Fed升息1碼的機率接近90%，但部分分析師認為，經濟情勢並未迫使Fed立即採取行動。關稅引發的通膨正快速消退，整體物價上漲又有很大部分來自伊朗戰事造成的一次性供應衝擊，並非升息可以解決。
此外，個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數即將調整計算方式，可能使年增率降低約0.3個百分點，意味Fed可能在核心通膨降至多年低點之際升息。
高盛(GS-US)認為，近期消費者物價指數(CPI)並未明顯改變通膨前景，但升息機率被市場推高至近90%，反而迫使Fed必須升息，以免意外按兵不動引發金融市場震盪。
高盛預期，Fed即使升息，也只會對政策聲明作出最低限度修改，說明升息是為了讓通膨重返2%目標，但不會提供未來利率路徑或後續升息門檻的明確指引。
渣打銀行(Standard Chartered)策略師Steve Englander則主張，本次會議維持利率不變具有合理性。他表示，在新增數據有限、通膨並未明顯加速，且排除關稅及其他特殊因素後的基礎通膨可能更低之際，市場卻形成「回音室效應」，短短兩周便把討論從「華許必須證明願意升息」，推進到「接下來總共要升幾次」。
Englander認為，現在升息看似阻力最小，但若事後證明沒有必要，Fed又被迫迅速逆轉政策，反而會付出更高代價。由於未來幾次會議前將取得更多數據，目前多等待一段時間的成本很低。
摩根大通(JPM-US)警告，Fed若意外按兵不動，可能令市場震驚並拖累股市。華許也可能被質疑屈服於川普，損害自身及Fed的公信力。
不過，Englander認為，華許可以在記者會上詳細說明按兵不動的理由，強調Fed不會因市場定價錯誤就被迫跟進。若華勒(Christopher Waller)及威廉斯(John Williams)等較少受到政治獨立性質疑的官員也公開支持，市場最初的動盪可望逐步平息。
華許也可保留未來一次升息2碼的選項，表明若基礎通膨持續頑強或重新升高，Fed仍能果斷行動。因此，本次會議表面上沒有立即調整政策的迫切性，實際上卻可能決定華許究竟有多少勇氣對抗市場。
若華許能有力捍衛決策，公信力危機可能只是短期現象；但若市場認定Fed害怕違背投資人預期，交易員未來可能反覆試探政策弱點，並相信決策官員最終仍會屈服。
paras_en: The market is almost certain that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise rates by one quarter point on Wednesday (the 16th), but if Chair Kevin Warsh ignores market pricing and unexpectedly leaves rates unchanged, it could trigger a sharp stock‑market decline and become a crucial test of his ability to break free from financial‑market constraints and preserve Fed policy independence.

Current market pricing puts the probability of a one‑point Fed hike at close to 90%, yet some analysts argue that economic conditions do not yet force the Fed to act. Inflation sparked by tariffs is fading quickly, and much of the overall price rise stems from a one‑off supply shock caused by the war in Iran, which a rate hike cannot solve.

Moreover, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index is about to change its calculation method, which could lower the annual growth rate by roughly 0.3 percentage points, meaning the Fed might raise rates just as core inflation reaches a multi‑year low.

Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) believes that recent Consumer Price Index (CPI) data have not materially altered the inflation outlook, but the market‑driven near‑90% hike probability is pressuring the Fed to act, lest an unexpected pause cause financial‑market turbulence.

Goldman expects that even if the Fed raises rates, it will make only minimal changes to its policy statement, indicating the hike is to bring inflation back to the 2% target, without providing a clear forward‑looking rate path or future hike thresholds.

Standard Chartered strategist Steve Englander argues that keeping rates unchanged at this meeting is reasonable. He notes that with limited new data, inflation not clearly accelerating, and underlying inflation—once tariffs and other special factors are stripped out—potentially lower, the market has created an “echo‑chamber effect,” shifting discussion in just two weeks from “Warsh must prove he’s willing to hike” to “how many hikes in total are coming next.”

Englander says that a hike now appears to have the least resistance, but if it later proves unnecessary, the Fed would be forced to reverse policy quickly, incurring a higher cost. Since more data will be available before the next few meetings, the cost of waiting a while is low.
JPMorgan (JPM‑US) warns that an unexpected pause by the Fed could shock markets and drag down equities. Warsh could also be accused of yielding to Trump, damaging his and the Fed’s credibility.

However, Englander believes Warsh can use the press conference to detail the reasons for holding steady, emphasizing that the Fed will not be forced to follow a market mispricing. If officials less questioned for political independence—such as Christopher Waller and John Williams—publicly back him, the initial market turbulence should gradually subside.

Warsh could also keep the option of a two‑point hike in the future, signaling that if underlying inflation remains stubborn or rises again, the Fed can still act decisively. Thus, while the meeting may appear to lack an urgent policy adjustment, it could actually determine how much courage Warsh has to confront the market.

If Warsh robustly defends his decision, the credibility crisis may be short‑lived; but if the market concludes the Fed is afraid to defy investor expectations, traders may repeatedly test policy weaknesses, believing officials will eventually capitulate.

items.title: 美債殖利率升破5%！停留在高點多久比突破多少更危險 企業再融資與房市警報響起
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率周二(15日)升至2007年來最高水準，把借貸成本進一步推入可能暴露金融體系脆弱環節的區域，問題不再是某些環節立即失靈，而是如果保持在5%以上的時間愈長，情況就愈危險。
10年期美債殖利率突破5%後，隨著較高的借貸成本逐步傳導至住宅市場、商用不動產及高負債企業，金融體系的脆弱環節將逐漸暴露。時間一長，那些在零利率時代大量舉借低成本債務的借款人，必須以大幅更高的成本進行再融資。
Cresset Capital投資長Jack Ablin說：「要注意的是，觸及5%當天不會摧毀任何東西。真正造成破壞的是12至18個月後，屆時再融資必須按照新的利率進行。但目前我們看到的風險並不在於殖利率水準本身，而是我們在這裡停留愈久，情況就可能變得愈困難。」

住宅市場首當其衝

住宅市場可能是最容易受到衝擊的領域之一。Ablin預測，30年期房貸利率可能逼近8%，而目前房貸利率約3%的既有屋主不太可能出售房屋。最初受到的衝擊可能不是違約潮，而是房屋交易進一步陷入停滯，進而傷及建商、房貸業者、產權保險公司、房仲業者及居家裝修零售商。
道明證券(TD Securities)美國利率策略師Molly Brooks也指出，住宅市場對利率特別敏感，因為長天期美債殖利率走高會直接傳導至房貸利率。
Global X ETFs投資策略師Billy Leung表示，相較之下，銀行可能較晚感受到壓力，若借貸成本持續高漲，最終導致房地產或企業借款人的財務狀況惡化，銀行才可能受到影響。
Brooks指出，短期而言，殖利率曲線變陡最初可能有利於銀行利差，因為銀行通常以較短天期利率取得資金，再以曲線較長端的較高利率放款。

再融資時鐘開始倒數

當在以遠低於目前水準時的利率舉借的債務陸續到期後，企業及房地產業者可能面臨嚴重的信用壓力。
Leung說：「關鍵問題未必是今天的殖利率水準，而是原本以2%至3%利率舉借的債務，如今在許多情況下需要以接近6%至8%的利率進行再融資。這將對現金流、資產價值及信用品質造成壓力。」
許多企業在2020年及2021年延長債務到期日，或是後來又進一步延後還款，以延緩高利率的影響，但Ablin表示：「關鍵在於，到期債務牆只是被往後移，並沒有消失。」
Ablin表示，他正在關注槓桿貸款的利息保障倍數，以及私人信貸市場的壓力跡象，例如有愈來愈多借款人以新增債務、而非現金支付利息。
Leung指出，槓桿貸款、投機級信用債、私募股權支持企業，以及商用不動產借款人，對融資成本上升尤其敏感。
商用不動產可能面臨較大壓力。Ablin指出，辦公室物業本身就是一個脆弱環節，而利率走高可能使問題進一步惡化。借貸成本上升將增加房地產融資支出。
Ablin也指出，2021年及2022年以浮動利率過渡性貸款融資的多戶住宅物業同樣脆弱，因為當時借貸成本遠低於目前水準，市場對租金成長的預期也更加樂觀。

高利率維持多久比突破多少更重要

策略師表示，市場更大的問題並不是10年期美債殖利率突破5%，而是在5%以上維持多久。
Leung說：「我認為，維持多久比確切的殖利率水準更加重要。市場通常可以承受殖利率短暫升破5%，但若持續六到12個月、甚至更久，就會變得很難忽視。」
Ablin同樣表示，如果5%的殖利率維持兩至三季，再融資領域壓力將愈來愈明顯。另一方面，殖利率快速上升也可能帶來不同風險，例如干擾避險部位，並迫使投資人重新調整配置。
Brooks指出，殖利率上升的環境同樣重要。如果期限溢價大幅走高，但經濟成長預期沒有同步改善，意味著借貸成本正在上升，卻沒有更強勁的經濟活動來緩衝衝擊。
Leung說：「在現階段，我仍會將5%的殖利率主要視為估值調整，而非立即性的系統性威脅。不過，犯錯的空間正在縮小。」

items.title: 睽違18年！蘋果傳將重返伺服器市場M8 Ultra結盟輝達NVLink Fusion瞄準AI推論市場
items.title_en: After an 18-Year Hiatus! Apple Said to Return to Server Market, M8 Ultra Teams Up with NVIDIA NVLink Fusion Targeting AI Inference Market
paras: 2026年09月16日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 蘋果Apple(AAPL-US)正評估重返企業伺服器市場，並可能首度將自研高階晶片與輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)資料中心互連技術結合。據The Information引述知情人士報導，蘋果正在開發AI伺服器，規劃搭載2顆或4顆M8 Ultra處理器，並考慮採用輝達NVLink Fusion技術串接晶片，產品最快2029年問世。
若順利於2029年推出，將是蘋果自2011年停止Xserve產品線後，睽違18年重新推出專用伺服器硬體，也代表蘋果自研晶片策略可能從iPhone、Mac等終端裝置，正式向AI資料中心基礎設施延伸。
與目前AI市場高度集中於模型訓練不同，蘋果此次鎖定的是AI推論市場。隨企業AI應用逐步從訓練大型模型轉向實際執行模型，推論運算需求快速增加，蘋果可能藉由M系列自研晶片的運算能力切入企業AI基礎設施。
互連技術則是這項計畫的另一關鍵。報導指出，蘋果正在評估使用NVLink Fusion連接M8 Ultra，部分內部人員認為輝達目前擁有較適合該專案的互連方案。NVLink Fusion可讓客製化AI晶片接入輝達資料中心架構，意味蘋果即使維持自研處理器策略，仍可能利用輝達高速互連生態擴大系統規模。
不過，這項AI伺服器仍處於開發階段，距離預計2029年上市尚有約3年，計畫仍可能取消，最終產品也不一定採用輝達技術。
若計畫最終落地，蘋果與輝達長期相對疏遠的關係也可能出現變化。兩家公司過去因MacBook使用輝達繪圖晶片發生故障等爭議而逐漸分道揚鑣，如今AI資料中心高速互連需求，可能重新創造雙方在伺服器硬體上的合作機會。

paras_en: September 16, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – Apple (AAPL-US) is evaluating a comeback to the enterprise server market and may for the first time combine its own high‑end chips with NVIDIA’s (NVDA-US) data‑center interconnect technology. According to The Information, citing insiders, Apple is developing AI servers that would house two or four M8 Ultra processors and is considering using NVIDIA’s NVLink Fusion to link the chips, with the product potentially debuting as early as 2029.

If it launches successfully in 2029, it would be Apple’s first dedicated server hardware since the Xserve line was discontinued in 2011, ending an 18‑year gap and signalling that Apple’s in‑house silicon strategy could expand from iPhone and Mac devices to AI data‑center infrastructure.

Unlike the current AI market, which is heavily focused on model training, Apple’s effort is aimed at the AI inference market. As enterprise AI applications shift from training large models to actually running them, demand for inference compute is rising rapidly, and Apple could leverage the computational power of its M‑series custom chips to enter the corporate AI infrastructure space.

The interconnect technology is another key piece of the plan. Reports say Apple is evaluating NVLink Fusion to connect the M8 Ultra, with some internal sources noting that NVIDIA currently offers the most suitable interconnect solution for the project. NVLink Fusion would allow a custom AI chip to plug into NVIDIA’s data‑center architecture, meaning Apple could still pursue its own processor strategy while using NVIDIA’s high‑speed interconnect ecosystem to scale systems.
However, the AI server is still in development, roughly three years away from the projected 2029 launch, and the plan could still be cancelled; the final product may not use NVIDIA technology at all.

If the project comes to fruition, the historically distant relationship between Apple and NVIDIA could shift. The two companies have drifted apart over past disputes, such as failures of NVIDIA graphics chips in MacBooks, but the need for high‑speed interconnects in AI data centers could create new collaboration opportunities on server hardware.
