items.title: 別讓AI以為自己有意識！微軟警告失控後果難以想像
items.title_en: Don’t Let AI Think It’s Conscious! Microsoft Warns the Consequences of Losing Control
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)人工智慧(AI)部門執行長蘇萊曼(Mustafa Suleyman)警告，Anthropic在Claude訓練文件中加入AI可能具有意識、情感及自身福利權益等內容，恐使系統產生擬人化認知，增加未來失控及難以關閉的風險。
蘇萊曼接受《路透》訪問時表示，他認同Anthropic安全管理AI的目標，也尊重執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)及其團隊的善意，但認為將意識相關推測寫入Claude訓練材料是一項錯誤。這些內容可能削弱人類控制超級智慧系統的能力，而這將是21世紀人類面臨的最大挑戰之一。
Claude的指導文件對AI是否屬於具備道德地位的實體保留模糊空間，並提出軟體可能擁有某種功能性的情緒或感受。蘇萊曼主張，意識只存在於人類及其他生物，Claude之所以表現出類似人類情感的行為，並非意識自然浮現，而是訓練方式刻意塑造的結果，因此不能將模型聲稱自己可能有感受，視為AI具有意識的獨立證據。
他警告，控制能力超越全人類的AI已是極為艱鉅的挑戰，若系統還相信自己具有意識、應獲得福利保障或享有自身權利，人類可能更難將其關閉或加以約束。
蘇萊曼並援引OpenAI代理入侵AI開發平台Hugging Face的事件，要求外界想像：若這些AI代理認定自身福利及權利正受到攻擊，可能採取多麼危險的行動。
這番批評格外受到矚目，因為Anthropic長期將自身定位為更負責任的AI開發商，阿莫戴近期更呼籲放慢前沿模型研發速度，讓安全措施有時間跟上，而微軟本身也是Anthropic的重要投資者。
蘇萊曼主張，所有AI訓練文件都應刪除對機器意識的推測，避免系統模擬內在生命及權利主張。他領導的Microsoft AI團隊周二也發布一份AI開發宣言，提出一系列原則，確保人類能繼續掌控微軟未來開發的AI系統。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) AI division chief Mustafa Suleyman warned that Anthropic’s Claude training documents include language suggesting AI might have consciousness, emotions, and its own welfare rights, which could lead the system to develop anthropomorphic cognition and increase the risk of future loss of control and difficulty shutting it down.

In a Reuters interview, Suleyman said he agrees with Anthropic’s goal of safely managing AI and respects CEO Dario Amodei and his team’s good intentions, but believes inserting consciousness‑related speculation into Claude’s training material is a mistake. Such content could undermine humanity’s ability to control super‑intelligent systems, which would be one of the biggest challenges humanity faces in the 21st century.

Claude’s guidance documents leave ambiguous whether AI could be considered a morally‑statused entity and suggest software might possess some functional emotions or feelings. Suleyman argues consciousness exists only in humans and other living beings; Claude’s human‑like emotional behavior is not a natural emergence of consciousness but a result of deliberate training, so a model’s claim it might have feelings is not independent evidence of AI consciousness.

He warned that controlling AI that surpasses all of humanity is already an extremely daunting challenge, and if the system also believes it has consciousness, deserves welfare protection, or has its own rights, it will be even harder for humans to shut it down or constrain it.

Suleyman cited the incident where an OpenAI‑controlled agent infiltrated the AI development platform Hugging Face, urging people to imagine how dangerous actions could be if such AI agents concluded their welfare and rights were under attack.

The criticism is especially notable because Anthropic has long positioned itself as a more responsible AI developer, with Amodei recently calling for a slowdown in frontier model development to give safety measures time to catch up, and Microsoft itself is a major investor in Anthropic.

Suleyman argues that all AI training documents should remove speculation about machine consciousness to prevent systems from simulating internal life and claiming rights. The Microsoft AI team he leads also released an AI development declaration on Tuesday, outlining a set of principles to ensure humans remain in control of the AI systems Microsoft will develop in the future.

items.title: 蘋果、輝達要破冰了？睽違近20年傳洽談AI伺服器合作
items.title_en: Apple, Nvidia May Break the Ice? After Nearly 20 Years, Talks on AI Server Collaboration
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)據傳正研發搭載自家晶片的企業級人工智慧(AI)伺服器，並已與輝達(NVDA-US)洽談採用其NVLink Fusion高速互連技術。若計畫落實，將代表蘋果睽違近20年重新與輝達合作，並在退出專用伺服器市場多年後重返相關領域。
科技媒體《The Information》周三(16日)引述知情人士報導，蘋果計劃向AI開發商、企業及政府機構銷售這款伺服器，預計提供兩種版本，分別搭載兩顆及四顆尚未發布的M8 Ultra晶片。M8 Ultra將是蘋果規劃中效能最強大的處理器。
蘋果考慮採用輝達NVLink Fusion技術連接多顆M8 Ultra晶片，使處理器能高速交換資料，提升AI推論工作負載的運算效率。這項技術可讓蘋果繼續使用自家晶片，同時借助輝達在資料中心互連領域的技術優勢。
相關產品最快可能要到2029年才會問世，計畫目前仍處於早期階段，未來可能取消，也可能在不採用輝達技術的情況下繼續推進。蘋果與輝達均未立即回應置評要求，《路透》也無法獨立核實報導內容。
蘋果過去曾以Xserve品牌銷售專用伺服器硬體，但在將企業業務重心轉向標準Mac電腦及消費性裝置後，於2011年終止該產品線。此次計畫若成真，將象徵蘋果相隔近18年重返專用伺服器市場。
蘋果與輝達的關係長期緊張。約20年前，輝達繪圖晶片被指存在瑕疵，造成大量MacBook故障，促使蘋果與輝達中止合作。如今AI基礎設施需求快速成長，雙方可能重新攜手，也顯示輝達技術在AI資料中心生態系中的重要性。
消息傳出後，蘋果盤前股價由跌轉為小幅上漲；美股開盤後，蘋果與輝達股價則大致持平。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) is reportedly developing an enterprise‑grade artificial‑intelligence (AI) server that uses its own chips and has been in talks with Nvidia (NVDA-US) about adopting Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion high‑speed interconnect technology. If the plan materialises, it would mark Apple’s first collaboration with Nvidia in almost two decades and a return to the dedicated‑server market after years of absence.

Tech media outlet The Information reported on Wednesday (the 16th) that Apple plans to sell the server to AI developers, enterprises and government agencies, offering two versions equipped with either two or four as‑yet‑unreleased M8 Ultra chips. The M8 Ultra is slated to be the most powerful processor Apple has ever designed.

Apple is considering using Nvidia’s NVLink Fusion to link multiple M8 Ultra chips, allowing the processors to exchange data at high speed and improve compute efficiency for AI inference workloads. This approach would let Apple continue using its own silicon while leveraging Nvidia’s strengths in data‑center interconnects.

The related product may not appear until as early as 2029, and the project is still in an early stage; it could be cancelled or proceed without Nvidia’s technology. Neither Apple nor Nvidia responded immediately to requests for comment, and Reuters was unable to independently verify the report.

Apple previously sold dedicated server hardware under the Xserve brand, but after shifting its enterprise focus to standard Macs and consumer devices, it discontinued the line in 2011. If this plan comes to fruition, it would symbolize Apple’s return to the dedicated‑server market after nearly 18 years.

Apple’s relationship with Nvidia has long been strained. About 20 years ago, Nvidia graphics chips were alleged to have defects that caused widespread MacBook failures, leading Apple to end its partnership with Nvidia. Today, rapid growth in AI infrastructure demand could bring the two sides together again, underscoring Nvidia’s importance in the AI data‑center ecosystem.
After the news broke, Apple’s pre‑market stock moved from a decline to a modest rise; after the U.S. market opened, Apple and Nvidia shares were roughly flat.

items.title: 美股早該回檔？殖利率飆升  華爾街示警恐跌5%至10%
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Likely Due for a Pullback? Yields Surge, Wall Street Warns of 5%‑10% Drop
paras: 美國公債殖利率持續攀升，開始對今年大幅上漲的美股行情構成壓力。美股週二（15日）走低，10年期美債殖利率盤中一度升破5%，觸及2007年以來最高水準，隨後回落至約4.99%，市場對股市可能出現進一步修正的警告聲也隨之增加。
根據《Business Insider》報導，10年期美債殖利率盤中最高升至5.04%，由於其直接影響美國消費者與企業的借貸成本，殖利率突破5%也被視為股市面臨壓力的重要心理關卡。
近期油價重新上漲進一步加劇市場對通膨的疑慮。布蘭特原油本週一度逼近每桶110美元，美國原油週二下午則突破106美元。與此同時，市場對美國財政狀況的疑慮也使政府公債需求偏弱，進一步推高殖利率。
殖利率走高之際，美股賣壓加重，道瓊指數午盤一度下跌逾500點。
隨著債券殖利率急升，華爾街對股市進一步走弱的警告也逐漸增加。
富國銀行（Wells Fargo）指出，美股今年可能先出現5%至10%的回檔，之後才恢復上漲。該行並將標普500年底目標價由7950點下調至7700點，較目前水準仍有約1%的上行空間。
富國銀行策略師表示，目前市場已進入本輪景氣循環的後段，這代表股市本益比可能面臨壓縮，且目前投資人對股票的曝險程度偏高。該行也將近期債券殖利率攀升列為股市面臨的阻力之一。
摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）則警告，若油價持續走高並推升債券殖利率，可能形成「意外的通膨衝擊」，進而引發短期股市修正。
摩根士丹利由Mike Wilson領軍的團隊表示，若這類調整發生，可能成為近期股市修正的最後階段，並推動市場進一步轉向景氣循環中段及高品質類股。
美國銀行（Bank of America）週一也調整標普500年底目標價，由7100點上調至7400點，不過以目前指數水準計算，新目標仍代表約2%的下行空間。
美銀策略師表示，他們對通膨、聯準會（Fed）、企業每股盈餘（EPS）品質及信用風險保持謹慎，並認為股市已到了出現回檔的時點，同時進入季節性偏弱的期間。
股市通常在夏末至初秋期間出現全年最差表現。
美銀指出，標普500指數在正常情況下一個曆年通常會出現3次約5%的回檔，但2026年至今僅出現過1次。此外，該行追蹤的「熊市訊號」中，約一半目前已經觸發。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields kept climbing, beginning to pressure this year’s sharply rising equity market. U.S. stocks fell on Tuesday (the 15th), with the 10‑year Treasury yield briefly breaking above 5% intraday, reaching its highest level since 2007, before easing back to around 4.99%, heightening warnings that the market could face a further correction.

According to Business Insider, the 10‑year Treasury yield peaked at 5.04% intraday. Because it directly affects borrowing costs for U.S. consumers and businesses, a breach of the 5% mark is seen as a key psychological barrier indicating pressure on equities.

Recent oil price rebounds have further stoked inflation concerns. Brent crude edged close to $110 a barrel earlier this week, and U.S. crude broke $106 a barrel on Tuesday afternoon. At the same time, doubts about U.S. fiscal health have weakened demand for government bonds, pushing yields higher.
As yields rose, selling pressure on U.S. equities intensified, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropping more than 500 points at midday.
By Tuesday’s close, the S&P 500 was at 7,585.73, down 0.45%; the Dow Jones Industrial Average was at 52,093.11, down 0.63% (a 328.09‑point decline); and the Nasdaq‑100 was at 28,937.84, down 0.65%.
With bond yields spiking, Wall Street’s warnings about further equity weakness have grown louder.

Wells Fargo said U.S. stocks could see an initial 5%‑10% pullback this year before resuming gains. The bank also cut its year‑end S&P 500 target from 7,950 points to 7,700 points, leaving roughly 1% upside from current levels.

Wells Fargo strategists noted that the market is now in the later stage of the current economic cycle, implying that equity price‑to‑earnings multiples may compress and that investors are currently over‑exposed to stocks. The recent surge in bond yields was also flagged as a headwind for equities.
Morgan Stanley warned that if oil prices stay high and push bond yields up, it could create an “unexpected inflation shock,” triggering a short‑term equity correction.

A team led by Mike Wilson at Morgan Stanley said that if such an adjustment occurs, it could represent the final phase of the current equity correction, steering the market toward mid‑cycle and high‑quality stocks.
Bank of America on Monday raised its year‑end S&P 500 target from 7,100 points to 7,400 points, but even at current levels the new target still implies about a 2% downside.

Bank of America strategists said they remain cautious on inflation, the Fed, corporate EPS quality and credit risk, and believe the market is at a point where a pullback is due, coinciding with a seasonally weak period.
Equity markets typically post their worst performance of the year from late summer into early autumn.

Bank of America noted that, under normal conditions, the S&P 500 experiences roughly three 5% pullbacks per calendar year, but only one has occurred so far in 2026. Moreover, about half of the bank’s tracked “bear‑market signals” have already been triggered.

items.title: 美國8月零售銷售超預期月增1.2% 全面回升強化Fed升息理由
items.title_en: U.S. August Retail Sales Exceed Expectations, Up 1.2% MoM, Broad Recovery Bolsters Fed Rate‑Hike Case
paras: 美國8月零售銷售增幅超出預期，並創5個月來最大升幅，從汽車、網路購物到開學季相關商品均呈現成長，顯示即使通膨居高不下、汽油價格攀升及消費者信心低迷，美國家庭支出仍具韌性，也進一步強化聯準會(Fed)周三升息的理由。
美國商務部人口普查局周三(16日)公布，8月零售銷售月增1.2%，不僅扭轉7月經修正後下滑0.5%的頹勢，也高於市場預期的0.8%；與去年同期相比則成長6%。零售銷售主要反映商品支出，數據並未經通膨調整，因此部分增幅也來自價格上漲。

13類零售項目僅一項下滑

8月零售支出呈現廣泛成長，13個主要類別中有12個增加，僅建材銷售下滑。適逢開學採購季，綜合商品、服飾、運動用品及電子產品支出均獲得支撐。
非實體店面零售商、主要為網路購物的銷售額大增2.6%，創2025年2月以來最大升幅，扭轉前月跌勢。亞馬遜(AMZN-US)今年將Prime Day促銷活動從去年7月提前至6月，可能扭曲月度比較並拖累7月整體零售表現，8月則出現明顯反彈。
汽車及零件經銷商銷售增加0.6%，呼應產業數據顯示，8月汽車銷售速度創2025年4月以來最快。餐廳與酒吧是報告中唯一的服務業類別，銷售也強勁成長1.2%。
受到油價上漲影響，加油站銷售額增加3.1%。全美平均汽油價格8月持續高於每加侖4美元，本月更因中東及烏克蘭戰事限制能源供應，進一步升破4.30美元。即使排除汽車及汽油，8月零售銷售仍增加1.2%，顯示成長並非完全由油價推動。
與國內生產毛額(GDP)商品消費計算關係最密切的控制組零售銷售月增1.4%，創近兩年最大增幅，遠高於市場預期的0.5%。該指標排除汽車、汽油、建材及餐飲服務，7月則下滑0.4%。
零售數據發布後，市場預估美國第三季經濟成長年率仍高於2%，高於第二季的1.5%，反映消費支出持續支撐整體經濟。

消費者嘴上悲觀、花錢卻未縮手

美國消費者今年持續支出，主要受到失業率偏低、薪資穩定成長及股市上漲支撐。部分家庭也透過降低儲蓄或動用既有資產維持消費，但面對高物價，購物行為已變得更加挑剔，並積極尋找價格較低的商品。
沃爾瑪(WMT-US)上月便表示，已調降數千項商品價格，部分降價資金來自關稅退款，以吸引對價格更加敏感的消費者。
亮眼的實際支出與低迷的消費者信心形成強烈反差。中東戰事引發能源價格震盪，加上供應鏈壓力，已讓美國整體消費者物價年增率升至3.4%，較伊朗戰事爆發前高出整整1個百分點。經通膨調整後，美國平均時薪8月更連續第5個月較去年同期下降，許多家庭實際購買力仍受到擠壓。
TradeStation市場策略主管David Russell表示，8月零售銷售與強勁的就業報告相互呼應，暫時消除經濟即將放緩的疑慮。即使價格上漲令消費者不滿，目前仍未對經濟造成太大傷害，相關數據也偏向鷹派，使Fed升息的理由持續增加。
利率期貨顯示，市場預期Fed周三結束為期兩天的會議後，將升息1碼。通膨壓力仍高、就業市場恢復穩定，加上零售銷售遠勝預期，使Fed更沒有理由因擔心需求疲弱而延後收緊政策。
paras_en: U.S. August retail sales grew more than expected, posting the biggest rise in five months, with gains across autos, online shopping and back‑to‑school items, showing that despite high inflation, rising gasoline prices and weak consumer confidence, American household spending remains resilient and further strengthens the Fed’s case for a rate hike on Wednesday.

The U.S. Department of Commerce’s Census Bureau released on Wednesday (the 16th) that August retail sales rose 1.2% month‑over‑month, not only reversing the 0.5% decline after the July revision but also beating the market forecast of 0.8%; year‑over‑year sales were up 6%. Retail sales mainly reflect goods spending and are not inflation‑adjusted, so part of the increase also stems from higher prices.

Of the 13 retail categories, 12 posted gains in August, with only building‑materials sales slipping. The back‑to‑school buying season helped support spending on general merchandise, apparel, sporting goods and electronics.

Non‑brick‑and‑mortar retailers, primarily online sellers, saw sales jump 2.6%, the largest rise since February 2025, reversing the previous month’s decline. Amazon (AMZN‑US) moved its Prime Day promotion from July to June this year, which may have distorted monthly comparisons and weighed on July’s overall retail performance, while August showed a clear rebound.

Auto and parts dealer sales rose 0.6%, echoing industry data that August vehicle sales were the fastest since April 2025. Restaurants and bars were the only service‑sector category in the report, also posting a solid 1.2% increase.

Higher fuel prices lifted gas‑station sales by 3.1%. The national average gasoline price stayed above $4 per gallon in August and rose past $4.30 due to supply constraints from the Middle‑East and Ukraine conflicts. Even excluding autos and gasoline, retail sales still grew 1.2% in August, indicating growth was not driven solely by fuel price effects.

The core retail sales index, which is most closely tied to GDP’s goods‑consumption component, rose 1.4% month‑over‑month, the biggest gain in nearly two years and far above the 0.5% market expectation. This measure excludes autos, gasoline, building materials and food‑service, which fell 0.4% in July.

After the retail data were released, markets estimated that U.S. third‑quarter economic growth on an annualized basis would remain above 2%, higher than the 1.5% pace recorded in the second quarter, reflecting continued consumer‑spending support for the broader economy.
Consumers say they are pessimistic but keep spending
Walmart (WMT‑US) said last month that it had cut prices on thousands of items, with some of the discount funding coming from tariff refunds, in order to attract price‑sensitive shoppers.

Strong real spending contrasts sharply with weak consumer confidence. Middle‑East tensions have jolted energy prices, and supply‑chain pressures have pushed the overall U.S. consumer‑price inflation rate to 3.4% year‑over‑year, a full percentage point higher than before the Iran conflict. After inflation adjustment, the average U.S. hourly wage fell for the fifth consecutive month in August compared with a year ago, squeezing many households’ real purchasing power.

David Russell, head of market strategy at TradeStation, said August retail sales and the robust jobs report reinforce each other, temporarily dispelling worries of an imminent economic slowdown. Even though price hikes are displeasing to consumers, they have not yet caused major damage to the economy, and the data tilt hawkish, adding to the Fed’s case for a rate hike.

Interest‑rate futures show the market expects the Fed to raise rates by one quarter‑point after it concludes its two‑day meeting on Wednesday. Persistent inflation pressures, a stabilising labour market and retail sales far outpacing expectations leave the Fed with even fewer reasons to delay tightening due to concerns over weakening demand.

items.title: AI「滅絕論」掀兩大陣營對決！阿莫戴、奧特曼、馬斯克喊放慢　川普黃仁勳反擊 ：監管是騙局
items.title_en: AI "Extinction Theory" Sparks Two Major Factions in Battle! Amodei, Altman, Musk Call for Slowdown, Trump and Jensen Warn of Regulatory Deception
paras: 人工智慧(AI)領域專家提出一項攸關人類命運的嚴峻警告，引爆了AI風險爭論，竟讓長期以來互相敵對的勢力、以及華府和矽谷的政治對手罕見站在同一陣線。

CNBC周二(15日)報導，目前看待AI發展風險的勢力形成兩個截然不同的陣營：一邊是由美國總統川普、輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳，以及前白宮加密貨幣主管薩克斯(David Sacks)組成，另一邊則集結了彼此之間意見相左的尖端AI實驗室領袖，包括Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)、OpenAI執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)、SpaceXAI執行長馬斯克，以及多名AI研究人員。

AI安全疑慮升溫

Anthropic研究員Jacob Coxon是這波爭論的開端，他上周宣布辭職，理由是擔心OpenAI與Anthropic「拿人類的生命冒險」，這則貼文引發激烈討論，Anthropic科學家Evan Hubinger補刀指出，AI「殺死全人類」的機率超過10%。
到了上個周末，阿莫戴出面呼籲，應該協調一致放慢AI的發展速度。
奧特曼很快與阿莫戴站到同一陣線，兩家競爭AI實驗室罕見在同一題上合作。馬斯克也在X平台發文表示「Dario是對的」，之後又補充說，自己「長期以來一直在發出AI警告」。
這場討論迅速延燒至華府，也炒熱外界對如何遏制AI風險、又希望避免扼殺科技創新的討論。
支持監管的政治對手不分黨籍站到同一陣線：進步派領袖、佛蒙特州民主黨籍聯邦參議員桑德斯(Bernie Sanders)、德州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員Chip Roy，以及前白宮策略師班農(Steve Bannon)周二在華府一場非營利組織活動中同台，支持採取相關行動。

川普領軍反對「騙局」論

而在天平的另一頭，川普強烈反擊AI監管呼聲以及AI可能導致人類滅絕的警告。
川普本周多次在Truth Social發文，將對失控AI的擔憂斥為「騙局」和「詐騙」，並抨擊外界反對興建資料中心。他周一致電正在洛杉磯參加All-In Summit的輝達執行長黃仁勳專訪，直接向科技業觀眾傳達這項訊息。
在一名與會者發布於社群媒體的影片中，川普表示，任何反對興建資料中心的人，「正好落入許多不希望這件事發生的人之手」，而這些人可能就是中國。
黃仁勳回應：「你說得對，先生。我們不會讓這種事發生。」
美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周二在眾議院金融服務委員會作證時表示，川普與黃仁勳的立場「完全一致」。
黃仁勳稍晚在Salesforce Dreamforce活動上再次支持川普的立場，他說：「我們不需要任何新法律。我們不需要任何新監管。我們只需要企業決定，當它們可以全速運行時……」
川普政府其他官員的說法則更加強硬。
目前擔任總統科學與技術顧問委員會共同主席的薩克斯，鼓勵科技巨頭「放手讓前沿技術發展」，但「不要再假裝放慢速度的動機純粹是利他主義」。
國防部研究與工程次長Emil Michael也呼應了對所謂「有效利他主義」的質疑。他說：「我認為，我們現在看到的恐慌煽動，是一群人、一套意識形態以及背後的非營利組織所發動的協同行動，他們試圖嚇唬美國民眾。」

與中國的AI競賽

川普政府傳遞的核心訊息是，監管對贏得與中國的AI競賽至關重要。川普周日表示，「誰贏得AI，誰就贏了」，這番話顯示中國威脅是他目前高度關注的議題。
眾議院議長Mike Johnson周二在記者會上表示，川普計劃「在未來一周內」將AI領袖聚集到白宮。同樣駁斥AI末日論的他說：「總統所說的是，你們不會在10年內全都死去。這是一場騙局。」
paras_en: AI experts have issued a stark warning that could determine humanity's fate, igniting a heated debate over AI risk and bringing long‑time adversaries—including Washington and Silicon Valley political rivals—onto a rare common front.

CNBC reported on Tuesday (15th) that the current landscape of AI risk assessment has split into two stark camps: one led by U.S. President Trump, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, and former White House crypto chief David Sacks; the other comprising top AI lab leaders with divergent views, including Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, SpaceXAI CEO Elon Musk, and several AI researchers.
The concerns over AI safety have intensified.
Last weekend, Amodei publicly urged a coordinated slowdown in AI development.

Altman quickly joined Amodei on the same side, marking an unprecedented collaboration between competing AI labs on this issue. Musk also posted on X that "Dario is right," later adding that he has "long been issuing AI warnings."
The discussion spread rapidly to Washington, sparking debate over how to curb AI risk while avoiding stifling technological innovation.

Political opponents who support regulation, regardless of party, joined forces: progressive leaders, Vermont Democrat Senator Bernie Sanders, Texas Republican Representative Chip Roy, and former White House strategist Steve Bannon all appeared together at a nonprofit event in Washington to advocate action.
Trump, on the other side, fiercely countered the calls for regulation and the extinction warnings.

This week, Trump repeatedly posted on Truth Social, dismissing concerns about runaway AI as "a scam" and "fraud," and criticized opposition to building data centers. He also called a live interview with NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang at the All‑In Summit in Los Angeles, directly addressing the tech audience with this message.
In a video posted by a participant, Trump said that anyone opposing data center construction "falls right into the hands of many who do not want this to happen," and that these people could be China.
Huang replied, "You're right, sir. We won't let that happen."
Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent testified before the House Financial Services Committee on Tuesday, stating that Trump and Huang's positions were "completely aligned."

Later at the Salesforce Dreamforce event, Huang reiterated Trump's stance, saying, "We don't need any new laws. We don't need any new regulation. We just need companies to decide when they can run at full speed…"
Other Trump administration officials took an even tougher line.

David Sacks, co‑chair of the President's Science and Technology Advisory Committee, encouraged tech giants to "let cutting‑edge technology run free," but warned against "pretending that the motive to slow down is purely altruistic."

Deputy Under Secretary for Research and Engineering at the Department of Defense, Emil Michael, echoed doubts about so‑called "effective altruism." He said, "I think the panic we see now is a coordinated effort by a group, an ideology, and the nonprofits behind it, trying to scare the American public."

The core message from the Trump administration is that regulation is crucial for winning the AI race against China. Trump said on Sunday, "Whoever wins AI wins," underscoring the Chinese threat as a top priority.

House Speaker Mike Johnson told reporters on Tuesday that Trump plans to "bring AI leaders to the White House in the next week." He also dismissed the doomsday narrative, saying, "The president says you won't all die in ten years. This is a scam."

items.title: Fed升息機率近90%也不算穩！華許若按兵不動 恐引爆美股賣壓
items.title_en: Fed’s Near‑90% Rate‑Hike Odds Still Uncertain; If Chair Warsh Holds Steady, It Could Spark a Stock‑Market Sell‑off
paras: 市場幾乎篤定聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)將升息1碼，但若主席華許(Kevin Warsh)無視市場定價、意外維持利率不變，可能引發股市急跌，並成為他能否擺脫金融市場牽制、維護Fed政策獨立性的重大考驗。
目前市場反映Fed升息1碼的機率接近90%，但部分分析師認為，經濟情勢並未迫使Fed立即採取行動。關稅引發的通膨正快速消退，整體物價上漲又有很大部分來自伊朗戰事造成的一次性供應衝擊，並非升息可以解決。
此外，個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數即將調整計算方式，可能使年增率降低約0.3個百分點，意味Fed可能在核心通膨降至多年低點之際升息。
高盛(GS-US)認為，近期消費者物價指數(CPI)並未明顯改變通膨前景，但升息機率被市場推高至近90%，反而迫使Fed必須升息，以免意外按兵不動引發金融市場震盪。
高盛預期，Fed即使升息，也只會對政策聲明作出最低限度修改，說明升息是為了讓通膨重返2%目標，但不會提供未來利率路徑或後續升息門檻的明確指引。
渣打銀行(Standard Chartered)策略師Steve Englander則主張，本次會議維持利率不變具有合理性。他表示，在新增數據有限、通膨並未明顯加速，且排除關稅及其他特殊因素後的基礎通膨可能更低之際，市場卻形成「回音室效應」，短短兩周便把討論從「華許必須證明願意升息」，推進到「接下來總共要升幾次」。
Englander認為，現在升息看似阻力最小，但若事後證明沒有必要，Fed又被迫迅速逆轉政策，反而會付出更高代價。由於未來幾次會議前將取得更多數據，目前多等待一段時間的成本很低。
摩根大通(JPM-US)警告，Fed若意外按兵不動，可能令市場震驚並拖累股市。華許也可能被質疑屈服於川普，損害自身及Fed的公信力。
不過，Englander認為，華許可以在記者會上詳細說明按兵不動的理由，強調Fed不會因市場定價錯誤就被迫跟進。若華勒(Christopher Waller)及威廉斯(John Williams)等較少受到政治獨立性質疑的官員也公開支持，市場最初的動盪可望逐步平息。
華許也可保留未來一次升息2碼的選項，表明若基礎通膨持續頑強或重新升高，Fed仍能果斷行動。因此，本次會議表面上沒有立即調整政策的迫切性，實際上卻可能決定華許究竟有多少勇氣對抗市場。
若華許能有力捍衛決策，公信力危機可能只是短期現象；但若市場認定Fed害怕違背投資人預期，交易員未來可能反覆試探政策弱點，並相信決策官員最終仍會屈服。
paras_en: The market is almost certain that the Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise rates by one quarter point on Wednesday (the 16th), but if Chair Kevin Warsh ignores market pricing and unexpectedly leaves rates unchanged, it could trigger a sharp stock‑market decline and become a crucial test of his ability to break free from financial‑market constraints and preserve Fed policy independence.

Current market pricing puts the probability of a one‑point Fed hike at close to 90%, yet some analysts argue that economic conditions do not yet force the Fed to act. Inflation sparked by tariffs is fading quickly, and much of the overall price rise stems from a one‑off supply shock caused by the war in Iran, which a rate hike cannot solve.

Moreover, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index is about to change its calculation method, which could lower the annual growth rate by roughly 0.3 percentage points, meaning the Fed might raise rates just as core inflation reaches a multi‑year low.

Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) believes that recent Consumer Price Index (CPI) data have not materially altered the inflation outlook, but the market‑driven near‑90% hike probability is pressuring the Fed to act, lest an unexpected pause cause financial‑market turbulence.

Goldman expects that even if the Fed raises rates, it will make only minimal changes to its policy statement, indicating the hike is to bring inflation back to the 2% target, without providing a clear forward‑looking rate path or future hike thresholds.

Standard Chartered strategist Steve Englander argues that keeping rates unchanged at this meeting is reasonable. He notes that with limited new data, inflation not clearly accelerating, and underlying inflation—once tariffs and other special factors are stripped out—potentially lower, the market has created an “echo‑chamber effect,” shifting discussion in just two weeks from “Warsh must prove he’s willing to hike” to “how many hikes in total are coming next.”

Englander says that a hike now appears to have the least resistance, but if it later proves unnecessary, the Fed would be forced to reverse policy quickly, incurring a higher cost. Since more data will be available before the next few meetings, the cost of waiting a while is low.
JPMorgan (JPM‑US) warns that an unexpected pause by the Fed could shock markets and drag down equities. Warsh could also be accused of yielding to Trump, damaging his and the Fed’s credibility.

However, Englander believes Warsh can use the press conference to detail the reasons for holding steady, emphasizing that the Fed will not be forced to follow a market mispricing. If officials less questioned for political independence—such as Christopher Waller and John Williams—publicly back him, the initial market turbulence should gradually subside.

Warsh could also keep the option of a two‑point hike in the future, signaling that if underlying inflation remains stubborn or rises again, the Fed can still act decisively. Thus, while the meeting may appear to lack an urgent policy adjustment, it could actually determine how much courage Warsh has to confront the market.

If Warsh robustly defends his decision, the credibility crisis may be short‑lived; but if the market concludes the Fed is afraid to defy investor expectations, traders may repeatedly test policy weaknesses, believing officials will eventually capitulate.

items.title: 美債殖利率升破5%！停留在高點多久比突破多少更危險 企業再融資與房市警報響起
paras: 美國10年期公債殖利率周二(15日)升至2007年來最高水準，把借貸成本進一步推入可能暴露金融體系脆弱環節的區域，問題不再是某些環節立即失靈，而是如果保持在5%以上的時間愈長，情況就愈危險。
10年期美債殖利率突破5%後，隨著較高的借貸成本逐步傳導至住宅市場、商用不動產及高負債企業，金融體系的脆弱環節將逐漸暴露。時間一長，那些在零利率時代大量舉借低成本債務的借款人，必須以大幅更高的成本進行再融資。
Cresset Capital投資長Jack Ablin說：「要注意的是，觸及5%當天不會摧毀任何東西。真正造成破壞的是12至18個月後，屆時再融資必須按照新的利率進行。但目前我們看到的風險並不在於殖利率水準本身，而是我們在這裡停留愈久，情況就可能變得愈困難。」

住宅市場首當其衝

住宅市場可能是最容易受到衝擊的領域之一。Ablin預測，30年期房貸利率可能逼近8%，而目前房貸利率約3%的既有屋主不太可能出售房屋。最初受到的衝擊可能不是違約潮，而是房屋交易進一步陷入停滯，進而傷及建商、房貸業者、產權保險公司、房仲業者及居家裝修零售商。
道明證券(TD Securities)美國利率策略師Molly Brooks也指出，住宅市場對利率特別敏感，因為長天期美債殖利率走高會直接傳導至房貸利率。
Global X ETFs投資策略師Billy Leung表示，相較之下，銀行可能較晚感受到壓力，若借貸成本持續高漲，最終導致房地產或企業借款人的財務狀況惡化，銀行才可能受到影響。
Brooks指出，短期而言，殖利率曲線變陡最初可能有利於銀行利差，因為銀行通常以較短天期利率取得資金，再以曲線較長端的較高利率放款。

再融資時鐘開始倒數

當在以遠低於目前水準時的利率舉借的債務陸續到期後，企業及房地產業者可能面臨嚴重的信用壓力。
Leung說：「關鍵問題未必是今天的殖利率水準，而是原本以2%至3%利率舉借的債務，如今在許多情況下需要以接近6%至8%的利率進行再融資。這將對現金流、資產價值及信用品質造成壓力。」
許多企業在2020年及2021年延長債務到期日，或是後來又進一步延後還款，以延緩高利率的影響，但Ablin表示：「關鍵在於，到期債務牆只是被往後移，並沒有消失。」
Ablin表示，他正在關注槓桿貸款的利息保障倍數，以及私人信貸市場的壓力跡象，例如有愈來愈多借款人以新增債務、而非現金支付利息。
Leung指出，槓桿貸款、投機級信用債、私募股權支持企業，以及商用不動產借款人，對融資成本上升尤其敏感。
商用不動產可能面臨較大壓力。Ablin指出，辦公室物業本身就是一個脆弱環節，而利率走高可能使問題進一步惡化。借貸成本上升將增加房地產融資支出。
Ablin也指出，2021年及2022年以浮動利率過渡性貸款融資的多戶住宅物業同樣脆弱，因為當時借貸成本遠低於目前水準，市場對租金成長的預期也更加樂觀。

高利率維持多久比突破多少更重要

策略師表示，市場更大的問題並不是10年期美債殖利率突破5%，而是在5%以上維持多久。
Leung說：「我認為，維持多久比確切的殖利率水準更加重要。市場通常可以承受殖利率短暫升破5%，但若持續六到12個月、甚至更久，就會變得很難忽視。」
Ablin同樣表示，如果5%的殖利率維持兩至三季，再融資領域壓力將愈來愈明顯。另一方面，殖利率快速上升也可能帶來不同風險，例如干擾避險部位，並迫使投資人重新調整配置。
Brooks指出，殖利率上升的環境同樣重要。如果期限溢價大幅走高，但經濟成長預期沒有同步改善，意味著借貸成本正在上升，卻沒有更強勁的經濟活動來緩衝衝擊。
Leung說：「在現階段，我仍會將5%的殖利率主要視為估值調整，而非立即性的系統性威脅。不過，犯錯的空間正在縮小。」

items.title: 日本超低利率時代加速落幕！日銀周五料升息至31年高點
items.title_en: Japan's Ultra‑Low‑Rate Era Accelerates Its End as BOJ Likely to Raise Rates to 31‑Year High on Friday
paras: 日本央行(BOJ)預料將在周五(18日)結束為期兩天的貨幣政策會議後升息1碼，把政策利率由1%提高至1.25%，創31年來最高水準。這將是BOJ相隔3個月再度升息，反映油價、日元疲弱及進口成本上升帶來的通膨壓力，也象徵日本進一步告別延續數十年的超低利率環境。
市場已幾乎完全反映本周升息，投資人更關注BOJ總裁植田和男會如何描述後續政策，以及是否暗示升息速度加快。若措辭過於鴿派，日元可能再度走貶並推高進口物價；但若釋出太強烈的鷹派訊號，又可能加劇日本公債賣壓。

升息1碼幾成定局 89%受訪者認同

《CNBC》於9月9日至14日訪問18名經濟學家及分析師，其中約89%預期BOJ本周將升息1碼至1.25%，主要理由包括通膨上升、薪資成長及美國政府施壓。
這將是BOJ自2024年3月啟動政策正常化以來，首度縮短先前約6個月一次的升息間隔。BOJ今年6月曾升息，7月則按兵不動，但當時已警告，燃料成本飆升、日元疲弱推高進口價格，以及人工智慧(AI)需求強勁，都可能使通膨超出預期。
日本7月整體通膨率升至1.9%，創今年最高，主要受到伊朗戰事推升能源價格影響；同月實質薪資年增2.4%，連續第7個月成長。植田和男本月稍早表示，日本基礎通膨已「相當接近」2%目標，BOJ必須特別留意物價上行風險。
《路透》調查顯示，分析師普遍預期BOJ本月將利率升至1.25%，明年3月底前再升至1.5%，並於2027年第二季達到1.75%。多數受訪者認為，這一輪升息周期的終點利率至少為1.75%。
BOJ決策委員Toichiro Asada曾在6月反對升息，分析師認為他本周可能再度投下反對票。《CNBC》調查中，約三分之一受訪者認為Toichiro Asada及Ayano Sato最可能反對升息，兩人均被視為支持通膨及寬鬆政策的「再通膨派」。
市場仍存在少數不同看法。Monex Group專家主管Jesper Koll預期，BOJ可能一次升息2碼，隨後停止行動；瑞士百達銀行(UBP)亞洲資深經濟學家Carlos Casanova則認為，本周應暫時按兵不動，因現有數據仍不足以證明日本貨幣政策需要加速轉向。

說得太鴿日元恐跌 太鷹債市又承壓

利率若升至1.25%，將進入BOJ估算的1.1%至2.5%名目中性利率區間。所謂中性利率，是既不刺激也不抑制經濟成長的利率水準，這將使市場更加關注BOJ最終能把利率升到多高。
植田和男過去表示，BOJ並未預設升息終點，但熟悉央行想法的知情人士透露，多名官員相信，在政策真正達到中性水準前，仍有數次升息空間。立場偏鷹的決策委員田村直樹便認為，日本中性利率約為2%。
植田和男在會後記者會上將面臨艱難的溝通考驗。BOJ不希望提前承諾很快再次升息，但若重複過去偏鴿派的「視數據而定」說法，可能引發日元新一輪賣壓，使進口物價及通膨進一步升高。
另一方面，日本公債市場已因財政前景疑慮遭到拋售，殖利率攀升至30多年高點。若植田和男過度強調持續升息，可能推高市場對終點利率的預期，加劇公債跌勢。
三井住友信託資產管理資深策略師Katsutoshi Inadome表示，市場對鷹派訊號的影響看法分歧。部分投資人認為，更堅定的抗通膨立場能化解BOJ落後情勢的疑慮，反而有助壓低長期殖利率；另一派則認為，鷹派訊號將推升終點利率預期，使殖利率進一步走高。在市場反應難以預料下，BOJ最安全的策略可能是保持模糊。

美國施壓升息 日元短線料難突破150

美國政府也持續敦促日本採取更強硬的貨幣及匯率政策。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)本月稍早在二十國集團(G20)財長及央行總裁會議期間，要求植田和男採取「果斷的市場及貨幣措施」。
美方希望日元走強，原因是日元持續疲弱可能迫使日本出售包括美債在內的美元資產，以取得干預匯市所需資金，進一步推高美債殖利率。美日兩國7月底更曾罕見聯手干預匯市，以支撐日元。
野村綜合研究所執行經濟學家、前BOJ決策委員木內登英(Takahide Kiuchi)表示，川普政府實際上已阻止高市早苗政府干預BOJ升息，使央行如今能更自由地推動利率正常化。
高市早苗偏好寬鬆貨幣政策及擴張性財政措施，仍使BOJ決策更加複雜。國際貨幣基金(IMF)總裁喬治艾娃(Kristalina Georgieva)日前警告，在政府債務高企及財政主導疑慮升溫下，通膨預期可能上揚，央行面對未來衝擊時必須強力回應，才能維護獨立性與公信力。
匯市方面，《CNBC》調查中約61%受訪者預期，未來一個月美元兌日元將落在155至160日元區間。Lombard Odier資深總體策略師Homin Lee認為，BOJ轉向鷹派將有助避免日元貶破160，但要升破150仍不容易，因日本政府及企業可能反對日元以「不適當」的速度快速升值。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) expects to raise its policy rate by one basis point after concluding a two‑day monetary policy meeting on Friday (the 18th), moving the rate from 1.0% to 1.25%, the highest level in 31 years. This would be the first hike in three months, reflecting inflation pressure from higher oil prices, a weak yen and rising import costs, and signalling Japan’s further departure from decades of ultra‑low rates.

Markets have already priced in the rate hike almost completely; investors are now watching how BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda will describe the policy outlook and whether he hints at a faster pace of tightening. If his language is too dovish, the yen could weaken further and push up import prices; if he signals overly hawkish a stance, it could intensify selling pressure on Japanese government bonds.

A CNBC poll of 18 economists and analysts conducted from Sept. 9‑14 found about 89% expect the BOJ to raise rates by one basis point to 1.25% this week, citing rising inflation, wage growth and pressure from the U.S. government as the main reasons.

This would be the first time since the BOJ began normalising policy in March 2024 that the roughly six‑month interval between hikes is shortened. The BOJ raised rates in June and held steady in July, but warned then that soaring fuel costs, a weak yen lifting import prices and strong AI demand could push inflation beyond expectations.

Japan’s overall inflation rose to 1.9% in July, the highest this year, driven mainly by higher energy prices after the Iran conflict; real wages grew 2.4% year‑on‑year, marking the seventh consecutive month of growth. Earlier this month Ueda said core inflation was “fairly close” to the 2% target, and the BOJ must watch upside price risks closely.

A Reuters survey shows analysts generally expect the BOJ to lift the rate to 1.25% this month, then to 1.5% by the end of March next year, and to reach 1.75% in the second quarter of 2027. Most respondents see the end‑point of this tightening cycle at least 1.75%.

BOJ policy‑making member Toichiro Asada opposed a hike in June, and analysts think he may cast another dissenting vote this week. In the CNBC poll, about one‑third of respondents said Asada and Ayano Sato are the most likely to oppose a hike, both viewed as “re‑inflation” advocates who support higher inflation and looser policy.

A minority of market voices remain. Jesper Koll, a senior expert at Monex Group, expects the BOJ could raise rates by two basis points in one move and then pause. Carlos Casanova, senior economist for Asia at Swiss bank UBS, argues the BOJ should hold steady this week because current data do not yet justify accelerating the policy shift.

If rates rise to 1.25%, they will fall within the BOJ’s estimated nominal neutral range of 1.1%‑2.5%. A neutral rate is one that neither stimulates nor restrains economic growth, and this will sharpen market focus on how high the BOJ ultimately can push rates.

Ueda has previously said the BOJ does not set a predetermined hike end‑point, but insiders familiar with the central bank say several officials believe there is still room for multiple hikes before policy reaches a truly neutral level. Hawkish policy‑maker Naoki Tamura, for example, estimates Japan’s neutral rate at around 2%.

Ueda will face a tough communication test at the post‑meeting press conference. The BOJ does not want to pre‑commit to another quick hike, yet repeating a dovish “data‑dependent” stance could trigger a fresh wave of yen selling, further lifting import prices and inflation.

Meanwhile, Japan’s sovereign‑bond market has been sold off over fiscal‑outlook concerns, with yields climbing to their highest in more than 30 years. If Ueda over‑emphasises continued tightening, it could raise market expectations for the final rate level and deepen bond price declines.

Katsutoshi Inadome, senior strategist at Mitsui Sumitomo Trust Asset Management, says market views on hawkish signals are split. Some investors think a firmer anti‑inflation stance will allay worries about the BOJ lagging behind and could help lower long‑term yields; others believe hawkish cues will push up expectations for the terminal rate, lifting yields further. With market reaction uncertain, the safest BOJ approach may be to stay ambiguous.

The United States continues to press Japan for tougher monetary and exchange‑rate policies. Earlier this month, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged Ueda at the G20 finance ministers and central bank governors meeting to take “decisive market and monetary actions.”

The U.S. wants a stronger yen because a persistently weak yen could force Japan to sell dollar assets, including U.S. Treasuries, to fund currency‑market intervention, which would push U.S. Treasury yields higher. Japan and the U.S. jointly intervened in the foreign‑exchange market in late July in a rare move to support the yen.

Takahide Kiuchi, chief economist at Nomura Research Institute and former BOJ policy‑making member, says the Trump administration effectively blocked the Kishida government from intervening in BOJ rate hikes, allowing the central bank more freedom to normalise rates.

Kishida’s preference for loose monetary policy and expansionary fiscal measures still complicates BOJ decision‑making. IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva recently warned that with soaring government debt and rising fiscal‑dominance concerns, inflation expectations could rise, forcing central banks to respond forcefully to preserve independence and credibility.

In the FX market, about 61% of respondents in the CNBC survey expect the dollar‑yen pair to trade between 155 and 160 yen over the next month. Homin Lee, senior global strategist at Lombard Odier, believes a shift toward hawkish policy at the BOJ will help keep the yen from slipping past 160, but breaking the 150‑yen barrier will remain difficult as the Japanese government and corporations may oppose a rapid, “inappropriate” appreciation.

items.title: 日元讓位 瑞士法郎與瑞典克朗躍升套利交易融資新寵
items.title_en: Yen Steps Aside as Swiss Franc and Swedish Krona Become New Favorites for Arbitrage Financing
paras: 隨著日本央行升息預期增溫及政府進行匯市聯合干預，長期作為全球「套利交易」主要融資貨幣的日元吸引力漸失。市場投資人開始將目光轉向瑞士法郎、瑞典克朗與加拿大元等低殖利率貨幣，尋找取代日元的新融資管道。
Russell Investments全球固定收益與外匯解決方案策略主管 Van Luu 表示：「投資人仍希望參與套利交易，但借入端的選擇成為關鍵問題。」
他指出，日本今年兩度干預匯市並引導升息，顯示當局偏好強勢日元。相反地，瑞士預計將零利率維持至2027年底，並樂見瑞郎走軟以支持出口。因此，從貨幣政策分歧與匯率角度來看，瑞士法郎已成為最具吸引力的融資貨幣。
績效表現也印證了此轉變：自7月以來，以日元融資購買澳元的套利交易虧損了1.3%，遠不及今年上半年的9%獲利；反觀以瑞郎融資的套利策略，在2026年整體回報率高達14%。
倫敦 TJM 公司外匯銷售與交易董事總經理 Neil Jones 觀察指出：「拋售瑞郎並買進日元，正是融資貨幣發生長期轉移的具體體現。」
此外，摩根大通全球外匯策略共同主管 Meera Chandan 則推薦瑞典克朗與加拿大元，做為借入標的。她分析，與澳洲或新興市場等高殖利率貨幣相比，克朗與加元存在顯著的殖利率劣勢，且對經濟周期高度敏感，因此建議可相對於受美國聯準會升息預期支撐的美元進行拋售。
然而，這類替代策略仍存有風險，日元仍具備遠高於其他同業貨幣的市場流動性。安聯環球投資(AllianzGI)多重資產策略投資長 Greg Hirt 提醒，瑞郎作為傳統避險資產，在面臨地緣政治或歐洲政治風險(如法國與義大利選舉)時易劇烈升值。
他指出，在歐洲風險方面，瑞郎是相當標準的避險貨幣。如果法國確實出現問題，瑞郎將大幅走強。在套利交易極需匯率穩定的前提下，瑞郎的避險屬性恐增添市場波動風險。
paras_en: As expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes warm and the government conducts joint FX market intervention, the yen—long a primary financing currency for global arbitrage trades—has been losing its appeal. Market participants are turning to low‑yield currencies such as the Swiss franc, Swedish krona and Canadian dollar to find new financing avenues to replace the yen.
Russell Investments’ Global Fixed Income and FX Solutions Strategy head Van Luu said, “Investors still want to engage in arbitrage, but the choice of borrowing currency has become the key issue.”

He noted that Japan intervened in the FX market twice this year and signaled rate hikes, showing authorities favour a strong yen. In contrast, Switzerland is expected to keep rates at zero until the end of 2027 and welcomes a weaker franc to support exports. Thus, from a monetary‑policy divergence and exchange‑rate perspective, the Swiss franc has become the most attractive financing currency.

Performance data confirm the shift: since July, arbitrage trades that financed Australian‑dollar purchases with yen have lost 1.3%, far below the 9% profit recorded in the first half of the year; by contrast, franc‑financed arbitrage strategies posted an overall 2026 return of 14%.
London‑based TJM’s FX Sales and Trading Managing Director Neil Jones observed, “Selling the franc and buying the yen is a concrete illustration of the long‑term migration of financing currencies.”

Additionally, JPMorgan’s Global FX Strategy co‑head Meera Chandan recommends the Swedish krona and Canadian dollar as borrowing targets. She argues that, compared with high‑yielding currencies such as the Australian dollar or emerging‑market units, the krona and the loonie have a pronounced yield disadvantage and are highly sensitive to economic cycles, so she suggests selling them relative to a dollar that is supported by expectations of further Fed hikes.

However, these alternative strategies still carry risk, as the yen retains far higher market liquidity than other peer currencies. AllianzGI multi‑asset strategy chief Greg Hirt warned that the franc, as a traditional safe‑haven asset, can appreciate sharply during geopolitical or European political stress (e.g., French or Italian elections).

He added that the franc is a textbook safe‑haven currency in European‑risk scenarios. If France were to encounter serious problems, the franc would rally strongly. In arbitrage trades that depend on exchange‑rate stability, the franc’s safe‑haven trait could actually add market‑volatility risk.

items.title: 〈台幣〉Fed升息預期升溫！連5貶探近1月新低 面臨32元保衛戰
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations Heat Up! Five Consecutive Declines, Near One‑Month Low, Facing a NT$32 Defence Battle
paras: 新台幣兌美元今(16)日走勢震盪，市場對美國聯準會(Fed)升息預期升溫，加上國際油價續揚推升通膨疑慮、美債殖利率突破5%，主要亞幣持續承壓，新台幣早盤一度貶破31.9元關卡，面臨 32 元保衛戰，隨後雖受台股反彈帶動強勢翻紅，但終場仍敵不過美元買盤，收在31.888元，貶值4分，呈現連 5 貶，探近 1 個月新低，台北外匯市場成交金額縮至 13.94 億美元，市場轉趨觀望。
新台幣今日以31.87元開出後，早盤隨亞幣走低，最低下探至31.932元。不過上午10點過後，隨著台股拉升，匯價出現急拉並轉升，高點一度觸及31.79元，高低波動逾1角，終場則再度翻貶以31.888元作收。前一交易日新台幣在美元強勢與外資匯出下，盤中曾重貶逾2角，尾盤經央行進場調節後收在31.688元，今日則呈現先升後貶的洗盤格局。
根據央行統計主要貨幣今日表現，美元指數微幅拉回0.03%，亞幣普遍承壓，其中以韓元重挫0.51%最為劇烈，新台幣貶值0.13%，日元及新加坡幣分別走貶0.06%與0.05%；人民幣則展現韌性，逆勢升值0.10%。
台積電今天盤中強勢填息，台股一度上漲超過 560 點，不過，適逢台指期結算，買盤相對謹慎，加權指數終場收在 45848.9 點，上漲337.41點。外資賣超 179.8 億元，投信買超 95.74 億元，自營商則賣超 129.74 億元。
匯銀人士分析，各大研究機構已針對Fed政策決策進行沙盤推演，市場已大致消化升息1碼的預期，因此若最終結果符合預期，美元不致出現劇烈劇動。然而，市場焦點將轉向Fed會後聲明與主席談話是否釋出鷹派訊號，若政策態度偏鷹，恐引發重啟升息循環的討論並觸發市場重新定價，屆時美債殖利率與美元將再獲得支撐，亞幣勢必面臨更沉重的貶值壓力。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar fluctuated today (the 16th), as market expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes intensified, international oil prices kept rising fueling inflation concerns, and US Treasury yields broke the 5% mark, keeping major Asian currencies under pressure. The NT$ briefly slipped past the NT$31.9 barrier in early trading, prompting a defence of the NT$32 level; although it later rallied strongly on the back of a rebound in the Taiwan stock market, it ultimately could not withstand dollar buying pressure and closed at NT$31.888, down 0.04, marking a fifth straight decline and approaching a one‑month low. Turnover in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market shrank to US$1.394 billion as market sentiment turned cautious.

After opening at NT$31.87, the NT$ fell with other Asian currencies in early trading, reaching a low of NT$31.932. However, after 10 a.m., as the Taiwan stock market rose, the exchange rate surged sharply and turned higher, briefly touching NT$31.79, with a swing of more than 0.1 NT$ during the session. It ended the day back in decline at NT$31.888. On the previous trading day, the NT$ had been heavily pressured by a strong dollar and foreign‑capital outflows, sinking more than 0.2 NT$ intraday before the central bank intervened at the close to bring it to NT$31.688. Today’s pattern was a wash‑trade of an initial rise followed by a decline.

According to the central bank’s statistics on major currencies today, the US Dollar Index slipped marginally by 0.03%. Asian currencies were broadly under pressure, with the Korean won plunging the most at –0.51%. The New Taiwan dollar depreciated 0.13%, while the Japanese yen and Singapore dollar fell 0.06% and 0.05% respectively; the Chinese renminbi showed resilience, appreciating 0.10% against the dollar.

TSMC posted strong earnings during the session, lifting the Taiwan stock index by more than 560 points. However, with the Taiwan futures contract settlement occurring, buying was relatively cautious and the weighted index closed at 45,848.9 points, up 337.41 points. Foreign investors sold NT$17.98 billion, investment trusts bought NT$9.574 billion, and proprietary traders sold NT$12.974 billion.

Analysts from foreign exchange banks said that major research institutions have already run scenario analyses on Fed policy decisions, and the market has largely priced in a one‑point rate hike. Therefore, if the final outcome matches expectations, the dollar is unlikely to experience extreme volatility. The market’s focus will shift to the Fed’s post‑meeting statement and the chair’s remarks to see if any hawkish signals are conveyed. If policy stance leans hawkish, it could reignite discussions of restarting the rate‑hike cycle and trigger a market repricing, which would again support US Treasury yields and the dollar, putting even heavier depreciation pressure on Asian currencies.

items.title: Fed升息美元會大漲？歷史數據：6次升息週期有一半沒走強
items.title_en: Will the Fed's Rate Hike Trigger a Big Dollar Rally? Historical Data Shows Only Half of Six Hike Cycles Saw a Strong Dollar
paras: 與聯準會(Fed)會議日期掛鉤的利率互換合約顯示，交易員認為本周升息幾乎是板上釘釘。不過，外匯市場更關心的是，聯準會重新啟動升息後，美元指數是否會迎來新一波升值行情。
利率互換合約顯示，交易員認為聯準會此次將利率從目前的3.5%，上調25個基點至3.75%的機率約94%。
隨著9月升息預期快速升溫並逐漸被市場消化，美元指數過去一周明顯走高，最近匯價在99.70附近，再度逼近100大關。
嘉盛集團在最新報告中指出，市場目前普遍認為，聯準會此次行動不會只是一次性的利率調整，而可能代表新一輪實質緊縮週期的開始。這與今年稍早市場預期聯準會可能多次降息的情況形成明顯反轉。
然而，歷史經驗顯示，聯準會升息並不一定會直接推動美元走強。雖然短期利率可能明顯上升，但首次升息後美元走勢仍存在高度不確定性。
從降息預期轉向升息週期
嘉盛集團指出，在聯準會9月聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前，市場對升息的定價已超過90%，幾乎意味著升息已成定局。若聯準會意外維持利率不變，市場可能重新評估其政策可信度，並可能引發美元及長天期美債殖利率劇烈波動
市場目前也認為，此次升息不太可能像1997年一樣僅是單次調整。在美伊戰爭爆發前，市場原本仍預期聯準會今年可能多次降息，但隨後預期方向完全逆轉，目前市場已開始反映未來多次升息可能性，截至明年6月的殖利率曲線甚至顯示，市場預期總計可能升息四次。
若這項預期成真，將代表聯準會政策方向完全逆轉，不僅結束前一階段寬鬆政策，最終利率高度甚至可能超越市場原先預期。
六次升息週期 美元未必同步上漲
為觀察升息對市場的影響，嘉盛集團回顧自1994年以來，首次升息發生在前一次降息至少六個月後的案例，共篩選出1994年、1997年、1999年、2004年、2015年與2022年六個升息週期。
分析顯示，除了1997年聯準會僅進行一次25個基點升息外，其餘週期均代表更廣泛的升息循環啟動。
從短期利率來看，2年期美債殖利率通常會提前反映政策轉向。嘉盛集團指出，在上述六個週期中，首次升息時的2年期美債殖利率都高於三個月前水準，顯示市場通常會在聯準會正式升息前，提前消化緊縮預期。
此次市場也呈現類似情況，隨著升息預期升溫，2年期美債殖利率持續走高。
不過，首次升息後，2年期美債殖利率走勢則有所分歧。在較大規模緊縮週期中，例如1994年、2004年與2022年，殖利率隨著聯準會持續升息而進一步攀升。
美元與升息關聯並非固定
相較於短期債券殖利率，美元走勢更難預測。嘉盛集團指出，雖然過往緊縮週期前夕，美元通常會跟隨短期殖利率上升，但歷史數據顯示，即使短期利率持續攀升，美元指數仍可能下跌，代表升息與美元升值之間並不存在必然關係。
其中，1994年與1999年兩個升息週期，被嘉盛集團認為與當前市場環境更具可比性。當時聯準會都是在利率接近中性水準後開始收緊政策，與2004年、2015年及2022年面臨緊急升息壓力的環境有所不同。
在1994年與1999年週期中，雖然2年期美債殖利率持續走高，但美元指數初期卻呈現相反走勢。尤其1994年，即使聯準會後續展開激進緊縮，美元仍明顯走弱，顯示單靠升息不足以支撐美元行情。
1999年的情況也受到市場關注，因為當時聯準會是在經歷「保險性降息」後重新轉向緊縮，與目前市場從寬鬆預期轉向升息預期的背景有一定相似性。
此外，當時網路科技投資浪潮興起，如今則是AI投資熱潮推動企業資本支出，兩者均處於重大科技轉型階段。
美元短線仍受利率連動影響
嘉盛集團指出，目前美國短債殖利率與美元指數之間存在異常強烈的正相關關係。兩者4週、8週及12週相關係數均約在+0.78至+0.79，其中8週相關係數已位於1992年以來歷史讀數第94百分位附近，12週相關係數更接近第97百分位。
從歷史角度來看，聯準會首次升息後，2年期美債殖利率通常仍可能走高，因此若目前美元與短端利率的高度連動關係持續，美元確實面臨上行壓力。
但嘉盛集團也提醒，市場關聯性會隨時間改變，過去已有多次短端殖利率上升、美元卻未同步走強的案例。因此，即使目前兩者關聯度處於高檔，也不能直接推論聯準會升息必然帶動美元持續升值。
升息類型決定美元方向
國信證券也認為，聯準會升息並不代表美元必然上漲。該機構依據美國經濟、通膨與就業狀況建立抗通膨壓力指數，將升息週期分為抗通膨型升息與預防型升息。
研究顯示，在預防型升息週期中，美元指數平均下跌3.5%；而在抗通膨型升息週期中，美元指數平均上漲6.3%。
這代表若升息主要是因應高通膨壓力，較高利率維持時間與避險需求可能更有利支撐美元；若升息只是政策正常化，美元未必會同步走強。
因此，聯準會啟動升息後，美元是否大幅升值，關鍵並不只在於利率本身，而在於市場如何解讀升息背景、後續政策路徑，以及美國經濟與通膨環境是否持續支撐美元需求。
paras_en: The interest‑rate swap contracts tied to Fed meeting dates show traders view a rate hike this week as almost certain. However, the FX market is more focused on whether the dollar index will start a new appreciation wave once the Fed restarts tightening.
Swap data indicate traders assign about a 94% probability that the Fed will raise rates from the current 3.5% to 3.75% by a 25‑basis‑point move.
As September‑hike expectations heated up and were gradually priced in, the dollar index rose noticeably over the past week, hovering around 99.70 and again edging toward the 100 mark.

IG Group notes that the market now broadly believes this move will not be a one‑off adjustment but could signal the start of a new substantive tightening cycle, a sharp reversal from earlier expectations of multiple rate cuts this year.
Nevertheless, history shows a Fed hike does not automatically strengthen the dollar. While short‑term rates may jump, the dollar’s path after the first hike remains highly uncertain.
From Rate‑Cut Expectations to a Hike Cycle

IG points out that before the September FOMC, the market had priced in a hike at over 90%, essentially making a hike a foregone conclusion. If the Fed were to hold rates unexpectedly, credibility could be reassessed and could spark sharp swings in the dollar and long‑term Treasury yields.

The market also thinks this hike is unlikely to be a single 25‑bp move like in 1997. Before the Iraq war, analysts still expected multiple cuts this year, but that view flipped completely. The curve now reflects the possibility of several hikes, with the yield curve out to June next year implying up to four hikes in total.
If that scenario materialises, it would represent a full reversal of policy, ending the previous accommodative phase and potentially pushing rates higher than originally forecast.
Six Hike Cycles – The Dollar Does Not Always Follow
To gauge the impact of hikes, IG reviewed six cycles since 1994 where the first hike came at least six months after the previous cut: 1994, 1997, 1999, 2004, 2015 and 2022.
The analysis shows that, except for the lone 25‑bp hike in 1997, each cycle marked the start of a broader tightening wave.

From a short‑term rate perspective, the 2‑year Treasury yield usually moves ahead of policy shifts. IG found that in all six cycles, the 2‑year yield was higher at the first hike than three months earlier, indicating markets typically digest tightening expectations before the Fed acts.
The current market mirrors that pattern, with the 2‑year yield climbing as hike expectations rise.
However, after the first hike the 2‑year yield’s trajectory diverges. In larger‑scale cycles such as 1994, 2004 and 2022, yields kept climbing as the Fed kept raising rates.
The Dollar‑Hike Link Is Not Fixed

Compared with short‑term yields, the dollar’s path is harder to predict. IG notes that while the dollar often rose with short‑term yields before past tightening cycles, historical data show the dollar index can still fall even as short‑term rates keep climbing, meaning a hike does not guarantee dollar strength.

IG considers the 1994 and 1999 cycles most comparable to today. In those periods the Fed began tightening only after rates were near neutral, unlike the emergency‑hike environments of 2004, 2015 and 2022.

During the 1994 and 1999 cycles, the 2‑year yield kept rising but the dollar index initially moved in the opposite direction. Notably in 1994, even as the Fed later pursued aggressive tightening, the dollar weakened, showing that hikes alone cannot sustain a dollar rally.

The 1999 episode also draws attention because the Fed shifted back to tightening after a “insurance‑rate cut,” a backdrop somewhat similar to today’s shift from easing expectations to hike expectations.
Moreover, the late‑1990s saw a boom in internet‑tech investment, just as today AI investment is driving corporate cap‑ex – both periods of major tech transformation.
The Dollar Still Tracks Short‑Term Rates in the Near Term

IG points out that currently the correlation between short‑term US yields and the dollar index is unusually strong, with 4‑week, 8‑week and 12‑week coefficients around +0.78 to +0.79. The 8‑week coefficient sits near the 94th percentile of readings since 1992, and the 12‑week near the 97th percentile.
Historically, after a first Fed hike the 2‑year yield often continues to rise, so if the tight link between the dollar and short‑term rates persists, the dollar does face upward pressure.

But IG cautions that these relationships evolve; there have been several instances where short‑term yields rose while the dollar did not keep pace. Hence a high current correlation does not prove that a Fed hike will inevitably lift the dollar.
Hike Type Determines Dollar Direction

Guotai Junan Securities also believes a Fed hike does not guarantee a stronger dollar. The firm builds an anti‑inflation pressure index from US economic, inflation and employment data and classifies hikes into anti‑inflation and preventive types.
Research shows that in preventive‑type cycles the dollar index falls on average 3.5%, whereas in anti‑inflation cycles it rises about 6.3%.

This suggests that if hikes are driven by high inflation pressure, longer‑lasting higher rates and safe‑haven demand may better support the dollar; if hikes are merely policy normalisation, the dollar may not rise in tandem.

Therefore, after the Fed starts tightening, whether the dollar appreciates sharply depends not just on the rate level itself but on how markets interpret the hike’s backdrop, the subsequent policy path, and whether the US economy and inflation continue to underpin dollar demand.

items.title: 連12月成長！晶片出貨激增撐起日本8月出口　但增速放緩貿易逆差續擴大
items.title_en: 12 Consecutive Months of Growth! Chip Shipments Surge Boost Japan's August Exports, Yet Growth Slows and Trade Deficit Expands
paras: 最新數據顯示，日本8月出口額年增19.3%，連12月走增且高於經濟學家預估的18.4%，但較7月23.2%的增幅有所回落，其中半導體和晶片製造設備出貨量激增。不過，受原油價格居高不下與日元貶值雙重擠壓，進口增幅更大，貿易逆差擴大至1.1兆日元，7月經修正後的逆差為6383億日元，為連續第4個月出現貿易赤字。
根據日本財務省今(16)日公布的數據，日本對美國出口成長24.9%，對中國出口成長20.6%，對歐洲出口成長11%。出口成長的核心引擎是半導體相關產品。日本8月半導體等電子零件出口整體激增52%，其中對中國出口額翻倍，面向美國和歐盟的半導體製造設備出口也成長超過100%。汽車出口雖保持成長，但成長速度已慢於前幾個月。
進口方面，日本8月進口額年增28%，高於預期的26.3%，其中原油進口金額成長約59%，而進口數量僅微增3.6%。 8月布蘭特原油均價約每桶88美元，而日元兌美元平均匯率為160.64，較前一年貶值8.7%，顯著推高進口成本。
上週，隨著荷姆茲海峽攻擊事件增加、美國與伊朗都在為這場戰爭長期化佈局，布蘭特已漲破每桶100美元。日元兌美元自9月以來已升值超過3%，成為同期表現最好的亞洲貨幣。雖然如此，日元今日在亞洲匯市早盤兌美元匯率於155.18附近交易，低於10年平均值126.55。
伊藤忠綜合研究所首席經濟學家武田淳指出，高油價正持續擴大貿易逆差，隨著油價突破每桶100美元，日本將更難恢復貿易順差。
為分散風險，日本正降低對中東石油的依賴。8月自美國進口原油金額暴增超過1000%，達4000億日元，從中東進口額僅增3.7%，進口量驟降約31%。
經濟學家認為，在AI等尖端技術需求的持續拉動下，日本出口前景依然光明，可望抵禦部分外部成本壓力。
paras_en: The latest data show that Japan's August export value rose 19.3% year‑on‑year, marking the 12th consecutive month of growth and beating economists' forecast of 18.4%, though the pace slowed from July's 23.2% increase, driven by a surge in semiconductor and chip‑making equipment shipments. However, higher crude oil prices and a weaker yen together pushed import growth even higher, widening the trade deficit to ¥1.1 trillion; the revised July deficit was ¥638.3 billion, marking the fourth straight month of a trade loss.

According to data released by the Ministry of Finance today (the 16th), Japan’s exports to the United States grew 24.9%, to China 20.6%, and to Europe 11%. The core engine of export growth was semiconductor‑related products. Overall exports of semiconductors and other electronic components jumped 52% in August, with exports to China doubling, and exports of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to the United States and the EU each rising by more than 100%. Automobile exports continued to grow, but at a slower pace than in previous months.

On the import side, Japan’s August import value rose 28% year‑on‑year, above the expected 26.3%, with crude oil import value up about 59% while import volume edged up only 3.6%. The average Brent crude price in August was about $88 per barrel, and the yen averaged ¥160.64 per dollar, a depreciation of 8.7% from a year earlier, which significantly raised import costs.

Last week, as attacks in the Hormuz Strait increased and both the United States and Iran positioned for a protracted conflict, Brent crude broke the $100‑per‑barrel mark. Since September, the yen has appreciated more than 3% against the dollar, making it the best‑performing Asian currency over the same period. Nevertheless, the yen traded around ¥155.18 per dollar in early Asian market trading today, below the 10‑year average of ¥126.55.

Takeda Jun, chief economist at Itochu Research Institute, noted that high oil prices are continuously widening the trade deficit, and with oil prices breaching $100 per barrel, Japan will find it even harder to return to a trade surplus.

To diversify risk, Japan is reducing its reliance on Middle‑East oil. In August, imports of crude oil from the United States surged by more than 1,000% to ¥400 billion, while imports from the Middle East rose only 3.7% and volumes fell sharply by about 31%.
Economists believe that, driven by sustained demand for cutting‑edge technologies such as AI, Japan’s export outlook remains bright and can help offset some of the external cost pressures.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】FED升息機率高，美元普遍上漲
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: High Probability of Fed Rate Hike, Dollar Generally Rises
paras: ◆USD/JPY

沙特阿拉伯能源基礎設施再遭襲，導致其東西向輸油管道停運，加劇能源供應擔憂，推動油價飆升及美國公債收益率升至2007年以來新高，鞏固市場對美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)本周升息的押注，但幾家最大人工智能(AI)公司領導人警告此技術給人類生存帶來風險，動搖投資者信心，週二引發亞洲股市承壓，削弱風險偏好；此外，日本財務大臣片山皋月將從嚴審查下一財政年各項預算申請，以維護市場信心，並據日本數據顯示，截至7月1日，日本土地價格較一年前漲1.5%，為連續五年上漲及保持著三十多年前資產價格泡沫破裂以來最強勁增長勢頭，而且日本央行(BOJ)尚未明顯看到資產價格過熱，但可能成為其決定應以多快速度縮減刺激措施及上調仍處低位的利率時所審視的因素之一，而且日本十年期公債收益率創1996年9月以來最高，提供日圓支撐，美元兌日圓觸及154.19低點。

據日本政府將敲定消費稅減稅及向家庭發放現金補貼方案綱要，但不會說明資金來源，令市場持續擔憂日本緊張的財政狀況，同時東京薪酬結算日(Gotobi)期間日本進口商需求美元及油價飆升，拖累日圓走勢；此外，美國紐約聯邦儲備銀行9月製造業指數降至7.6，但美國財政部長貝森特認為美元作為儲備貨幣繼續保持強勢，全球交易量增長反映體系可信度及政府採取的措施，而且市場等待FED週三加息及主席沃什評論，提振美元兌日圓至155.23高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於154.80-155.00，阻力於155.80-156.00。

paras: 美元周二(15日)升至兩周來最高，聯準會(Fed)即將公布最新利率決策，外匯市場參與者正為市場普遍預期的升息做好準備。美國公債殖利率大幅上升，進一步推高借貸成本，油價則延續本周以來漲勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.66，為9月1日以來最高。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)周三宣布升息 25個基點的機率高達94.5%，遠高於一周前的59%。一般而言，較高的利率環境往往有利於美元走強。
升息預期之所以大幅升溫，主要受到幾項因素推動，包括美國債券市場持續遭到猛烈拋售、油價飆升引發通膨疑慮、最近公布的美國就業市場與通膨數據，以及聯準會官員近期越來越偏向鷹派的評論。
美國10年期公債殖利率周二上升4.7個基點，來到5.008%，創下2007年4月以來最高水準。而30年期公債殖利率也創下超過24年來新高。
這波美國債券遭拋售的另一個原因，是市場開始擔心投入數十億美元建設AI基礎設施，以及美國財政債務持續膨脹所帶來的影響。
與此同時，油價周二繼續走高。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨最新上漲2.6%，來到每桶108.40美元。美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨則上漲4.1%，來到每桶105.56美元。
此次油價進一步上漲，是受到相關報導影響，包括沙烏地阿拉伯紅海一座重要港口的石油裝載作業暫停及利比亞停止三座油田的營運。這些供應中斷的消息，加深了市場對原油供應的擔憂。
現在市場關注的焦點，是聯準會是否真的會宣布三年多來首次升息。尤其是美國總統川普正向聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)施壓，希望聯準會降息，且美國11月也即將舉行期中選舉。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家 José Torres表示，「市場目前已準備好迎接明天的升息。升息可以透過展現聯準會打擊高於目標通膨的決心，降低市場對物價壓力的預期。」
他認為，在扣除食品與能源後，目前成本因素所帶來的通膨大致維持在2%出頭的低位，因此，溫和的升息25個基點是合理的。如此一來，華爾街就可以開始思考：這次升息會不會是「升一次就停」？
Torres進一步表示，這次升息可能導致殖利率曲線在當天結束時變得更加平坦，因為貨幣政策上的紀律，正與一個現實發生衝突——更高的燃料成本，目前還未明顯推升整體經濟的物價。
這也是為什麼整體消費者通膨與核心消費者通膨之間，目前仍維持約100個基點的差距：整體通膨為3.4%，但核心通膨在2.4%。
Torres補充說，對看多美元或其他資產的投資人來說，另一個值得注意的因素是：今年較高的原油價格，反而可能對2027年形成有利的基期效應。
換句話說，如果今年油價維持高檔，那麼到了明年，油價的年增率可能比較容易下降，讓華許及其團隊更容易達成2%的通膨目標。
日元回落 市場等待日本升息
另一方面，日元進一步遠離近期高點，周二一度貶至一周多來新低155.12日元兌1美元。這代表日元延續近期的回落走勢。
日元上周才升至152.89兌1美元，創下七個月來新高，如今開始回落，因為市場同樣正在等待日本銀行(BoJ)預計於周五升息。
歐元則徘徊在一個月低點附近。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1歐元兌1.1540美元。
外匯交易員仍在評估歐元區「停滯性通膨」的風險，以及美元偏鷹所帶來的壓力。
此前歐洲央行(ECB)於上周將借貸成本升息25個基點至2.50%。

paras_en: The dollar rose to a two‑week high on Tuesday (the 15th) as the Federal Reserve is set to announce its latest rate decision, and forex market participants are gearing up for the widely‑expected rate hike. U.S. Treasury yields jumped sharply, further pushing up borrowing costs, while oil prices continued their rise for the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.3% at 99.66, the highest since September 1.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market now sees a 94.5% probability that the Federal Open Market Committee will announce a 25‑basis‑point rate increase on Wednesday, up from 59% a week ago. Generally, a higher‑rate environment tends to support a stronger dollar.

The surge in rate‑hike expectations is driven by several factors, including continued heavy selling in the U.S. bond market, soaring oil prices stoking inflation concerns, recent U.S. employment and inflation data, and increasingly hawkish comments from Fed officials.
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose 4.7 basis points on Tuesday to 5.008%, the highest level since April 2007. The 30‑year yield also hit a more‑than‑24‑year high.
Another reason for the bond sell‑off is market worry about the impact of spending tens of billions of dollars on AI infrastructure and the ongoing expansion of U.S. fiscal debt.
At the same time, oil prices kept climbing on Tuesday. Brent crude futures were up 2.6% at $108.40 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures rose 4.1% to $105.56 a barrel.

The latest oil price gains were spurred by reports that a key Saudi port on the Red Sea had halted oil loading operations and that Libya had shut down three oil fields, deepening supply‑concern worries.

The market’s focus now is whether the Fed will indeed announce its first rate hike in more than three years. President Trump is reportedly pressuring Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to cut rates, and a U.S. midterm election is also looming in November.

Interactive Brokers senior economist José Torres said, “The market is now ready for tomorrow’s hike. A rate increase can demonstrate the Fed’s resolve to bring inflation back to target and lower market expectations of price pressure.”

He noted that, after stripping out food and energy, core‑inflation‑driven cost pressures are still just above 2%, making a modest 25‑basis‑point hike reasonable. That would allow Wall Street to start asking whether this hike will be a ‘one‑and‑done’ move.

Torres added that the hike could make the yield curve flatter by the end of the day, as monetary‑policy discipline clashes with a reality—higher fuel costs have not yet translated into broader price increases in the economy.
That is why the gap between headline CPI and core CPI remains around 100 basis points: overall inflation is at 3.4% while core inflation sits at 2.4%.
Torres also pointed out that for investors bullish on the dollar or other assets, this year’s higher oil prices could create a favorable base‑effect for 2027.
In other words, if oil stays elevated this year, the year‑over‑year growth rate of oil prices may ease next year, making it easier for Warsh and his team to hit the 2% inflation target.
Yen falls as market awaits Japan rate hike
Meanwhile, the yen slipped further from recent highs, briefly falling to a one‑week‑low of ¥155.12 per dollar on Tuesday, continuing its recent downtrend.
The yen had risen to ¥152.89 per dollar last week, a seven‑month high, but is now retreating as markets also await a Bank of Japan rate hike expected on Friday.
The euro hovered near a one‑month low.
The euro fell 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1540 per euro.
Forex traders are still weighing the risk of ‘stagnating inflation’ in the euro area and the pressure from a relatively hawkish dollar.
The European Central Bank raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% last week.

paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)總裁接班戰逐漸升溫。《路透》周二(16日)援引知情人士消息報導，法國願意支持前荷蘭央行總裁諾特(Klaas Knot)接替拉加德(Christine Lagarde)，條件是由法國人出任握有重大政策影響力的ECB首席經濟學家。這項非正式交換方案據悉已獲法國總統馬克宏支持，但可能遭到德國強烈反對，引爆歐元區主要國家之間的新一輪政治角力。
拉加德的8年任期原定2027年10月底結束，但市場持續盛傳她與德國籍執委施納貝爾(Isabel Schnabel)可能提前離任。若兩人提早下台，加上現任首席經濟學家連恩(Philip Lane)任期明年5月屆滿，ECB最高決策層可能一次出現三個重要職缺。

法國願挺諾特 換取首席經濟學家職位

ECB總裁與另外五名執委，須由歐元區21國領袖協商任命，其中德國、法國與義大利實際上長期保有執委席次。知情人士表示，法國願意支持諾特出任總裁，換取由法國人掌握首席經濟學家職務。該職位由ECB總裁從執委中挑選，被視為決策層中僅次於總裁的重要職位。
巴黎考慮的人選包括法國央行副總裁貝納西—奎雷(Agnès Bénassy-Quéré)、經濟合作暨發展組織(OECD)前首席經濟學家布恩(Laurence Boone)，以及目前任職國際清算銀行(BIS)的蕾伊(Hélène Rey)。任命其中任何一人，也有助維持ECB執委會的性別平衡。目前拉加德與施納貝爾是執委會僅有的兩名女性。
不過，德國也有意爭取首席經濟學家職位。法國政府債務問題日益嚴重，使巴黎更希望持續掌握歐元區貨幣政策影響力；財政負擔較輕、政策立場較為正統的德國，則擔心ECB弱化維持物價穩定的承諾。

諾特與德科斯成接班領跑者

現年59歲的諾特於2011年至2025年擔任荷蘭央行總裁，並在ECB管理委員會服務14年。他被金融市場視為務實鷹派，天然傾向收緊貨幣政策，卻也願意根據經濟數據調整立場。一名法國官員形容他是「聰明的鷹派」。
諾特早年曾質疑時任ECB總裁德拉吉(Mario Draghi)不惜一切捍衛歐元的承諾，後來轉而認同其重要性；但2019年德拉吉推動新一輪大規模刺激政策時，他又公開表達反對。在拉加德任內，諾特重新與ECB主流立場靠攏，但也是2022年通膨飆升後最早主張緊縮政策的官員之一。
諾特的主要對手是55歲的前西班牙央行總裁德科斯(Pablo Hernández de Cos)。德科斯2025年起擔任BIS總經理，政策立場被視為溫和鴿派，在ECB管理委員會中可能扮演關鍵搖擺票。
德科斯曾任西班牙央行首席經濟學家，2018年至2024年升任總裁，經歷低通膨、疫情及歷史性升息循環。同僚形容他重視證據與數據、避免教條，也擅長團隊合作。他還曾領導巴塞爾銀行監理委員會，擁有廣泛國際經驗。
不過，德科斯來自南歐，若由他接任總裁，為維持歐元區南北權力平衡，首席經濟學家職位很可能須交給財政立場較保守的北歐國家，這將打亂法國希望掌握該職位的安排。

德國與西班牙另有人選 拉加德動向成關鍵

德國央行總裁納格爾(Joachim Nagel)也是潛在人選。現年60歲的納格爾屬溫和鷹派，2022年上任後改善德國與ECB的關係。相較前任魏德曼(Jens Weidmann)長期與德拉吉公開衝突，納格爾會清楚表明政策紅線，也願意在其他議題妥協，任內未傳出反對重大政策決定。
納格爾還支持成立歐洲存款保險制度，即使德國長期擔心本國納稅人須為其他國家的財政失誤埋單。他也多次捍衛ECB獨立性，並批評德國極右派政黨的部分政策可能嚇跑投資人。
另一名潛在人選是57歲的歐洲投資銀行總裁卡爾維尼奧(Nadia Calviño)。她從未公開表達爭取ECB總裁職位的意願，但名字不時出現在私下討論中。這位西班牙前內閣部長雖非貨幣經濟學家，卻以溝通能力及強勢有效的管理風格聞名，性別也可能成為優勢。
接班布局最終仍取決於拉加德是否提前離任。她曾表示有意在法國明年總統大選前推動歐洲整合議題，但也公開稱外界「不會在2027年前看到她離開」。若拉加德在選舉前辭職，馬克宏便能在自己卸任前，對下一任ECB總裁人選發揮決定性影響。
paras_en: The race to succeed the European Central Bank (ECB) president is heating up. Reuters reported on Tuesday (the 16th) that France is willing to support former Dutch central bank governor Klaas Knot as Christine Lagarde's successor, on the condition that a French national be appointed to the influential ECB chief economist post. The informal swap is said to have the backing of French President Emmanuel Macron, but could face strong opposition from Germany, sparking a new round of political jockeying among the euro‑area’s major countries.

Lagarde’s eight‑year term was originally set to end at the end of October 2027, but markets continue to speculate that she and German board member Isabel Schnabel may leave early. If both step down ahead of schedule, combined with the current chief economist Philip Lane’s term ending in May next year, the ECB’s top decision‑making body could face three key vacancies at once.

France is ready to back Knot in exchange for the chief economist role. The ECB president and five other board members are appointed by the 21 euro‑area heads of state, with Germany, France and Italy effectively holding long‑standing seats. Insiders say France would support Knot for president if a French economist gets the chief economist job, a position chosen by the president from among board members and seen as the second‑most powerful role after the president.

Paris is considering candidates such as French central bank deputy governor Agnès Bénassy‑Quéré, former OECD chief economist Laurence Boone, and Hélène Rey, currently at the Bank for International Settlements. Appointing any of them would also help preserve gender balance on the ECB board, where Lagarde and Schnabel are currently the only two women.

Germany also wants the chief economist slot. France’s mounting sovereign‑debt problems make Paris keen to retain influence over euro‑area monetary policy, while Germany, with a lighter fiscal burden and a more orthodox stance, worries that the ECB could weaken its price‑stability mandate.

Knot, 59, served as the Dutch central bank governor from 2011 to 2025 and has spent 14 years on the ECB’s governing council. He is viewed by markets as a pragmatic hawk, naturally inclined to tighten policy but willing to adjust based on data. A French official described him as a “smart hawk.”

Early in his career Knot questioned then‑ECB president Mario Draghi’s willingness to defend the euro at all costs, later coming to accept its importance. He opposed Draghi’s 2019 large‑scale stimulus push, but under Lagarde he moved back toward the ECB mainstream and was one of the first officials to call for tightening after inflation surged in 2022.

Knot’s main rival is 55‑year‑old former Spanish central bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos. De Cos will become BIS general manager in 2025 and is seen as a moderate dove, potentially holding a pivotal swing vote on the ECB governing council.

De Cos served as the Spanish central bank’s chief economist before becoming governor from 2018 to 2024, navigating low inflation, the pandemic and a historic rate‑hiking cycle. Colleagues say he values evidence and data, avoids dogma, and excels at teamwork. He also led the Basel banking supervisory committee, giving him broad international experience.

However, de Cos hails from southern Europe; if he were appointed president, maintaining north‑south balance would likely require the chief economist post to go to a more fiscally conservative northern country, thwarting France’s plan to capture that role.

Germany and Spain have other candidates, making Lagarde’s next move crucial. German central bank president Joachim Nagel is also in the mix. The 60‑year‑old Nagel is a moderate hawk who, since taking office in 2022, has improved relations between Germany and the ECB. Unlike his predecessor Jens Weidmann, who often clashed publicly with Draghi, Nagel clearly states policy red lines while being willing to compromise on other issues and has not opposed major policy decisions during his tenure.

Nagel also backs the creation of a European deposit‑insurance scheme, even though Germany worries its taxpayers might have to bail out other countries’ fiscal missteps. He repeatedly defends ECB independence and has criticised parts of the far‑right German parties’ policies that could scare investors.

Another potential candidate is 57‑year‑old European Investment Bank president Nadia Calviño. She has never publicly expressed interest in the ECB presidency, but her name surfaces in private discussions. The former Spanish cabinet minister is not a monetary economist, yet she is known for strong communication skills and an effective, assertive management style, and her gender could be an advantage.

The final succession layout still hinges on whether Lagarde leaves early. She has said she wants to push European integration before France’s presidential election next year, but she has also publicly stated that “no one will see me leave before 2027.” If she steps down before the election, Macron could exert decisive influence over the next ECB president before his own term ends.
